text.title: 见证者与英雄
text.objectives: 唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔希望你去阅读第一份历史卷轴、第二份历史卷轴和第三份历史卷轴。
text.description: 踏上诺森德的征程后，我在北风苔原首次遇到了牦牛人。驯风者巴兰向我讲诉了雷蹄的传说，以及他对抗牦牛人部族的宿敌“北风”的英勇事迹。$B$B于是我来到风暴峭壁，想要了解更多有关这位英雄的故事。奇怪的是，唐卡洛营地的居民似乎对他一无所知。$B$B或许我们能从营地的档案中找到一些重要的线索。我要你去寻找并阅读营地中的历史书卷，然后告诉我你从中了解到了什么。
text.progress: 你从唐卡洛营地的档案里查出了些什么？
text.completion: 这可奇怪了……听起来跟驯风者巴兰告诉我的故事不一样。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。

english.title: The Witness and the Hero
english.objectives: Xarantaur, at Camp Tunka'lo, wants you to read the First History Scroll, the Second History Scroll, and the Third History Scroll.
english.description: When I began my travels in Northrend, I visited the Borean Tundra and met the taunka for the first time. There, Wind Tamer Barah told me the tale of Stormhoof and his battle against the North Wind, their people's ancient enemy.$B$BI set out for the Storm Peaks to learn more of this hero, but strangely, the people of Tunka'lo seem to know nothing of him.$B$BPerhaps the camp's own records will give us greater insight. Find and read the history scrolls kept throughout the camp, then tell me what you learned.
english.progress: What have you learned from the records of Camp Tunka'lo?
english.completion: How peculiar... that doesn't sound like the story Wind Tamer Barah told me.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 洛肯的副官
text.objectives: 托里姆要你杀死塑造者之厅的伊森法斯、造物者圣台的风之哈勒弗尼尔和符文巨人杜洛恩。
text.description: 洛肯早就策划好了对造物者圣台的进攻策略。他派出了铁矮人军团以及几名最得力的副官。$B$B使用峭壁号角召唤土灵，在他们的帮助下击败洛肯的仆从。$B$B你可以在北面的塑造者之厅找到巨人伊森法斯，然后沿着西北方的台阶进入造物者圣台，击杀其馀的副官。
text.progress: 再次见到你真好，$N。
text.completion: 一个接着一个，我兄弟的仆人都倒下了。洛肯的叛乱很快就将终结。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找造物者圣台的托里姆。

english.title: Loken's Lackeys
english.objectives: Thorim wants you to slay Eisenfaust inside the Hall of the Shaper and Halefnir the Windborn and Duronn the Runeforged in the Terrace of the Makers.
english.description: The attack on the Terrace of the Makers was not a half-hearted move on my brother's behalf.  He sent a legion of iron dwarves and some of his most powerful lieutenants.$B$BUse the Horn of the Peaks to call the earthen to your side and defeat Loken's servants.$B$BYou'll find the giant, Eisenfaust, inside the Hall of the Shaper to the north.  You'll find the others deeper inside the Terrace of the Makers, beyond the stairs to the northwest.
english.progress: It's good to see you again, $N.
english.completion: One by one, my brother's servants have fallen.  Loken's insurrection will soon come to an end.
english.completed: Return to Thorim at Terrace of the Makers in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 无上的荣耀
text.objectives: 向冰冠冰川银色前线基地的北伐军指挥官恩塔里报到。
text.description: 年轻的$c，自从我们走上漫长的救赎之路，一路征战，历尽艰辛，终于来到了这里。现在我们将面对最艰巨的挑战：消灭巫妖王和他的天灾军团。$B$B唉，我们只能独自迎接这场战争。部落和联盟互相打得不可开交，无法向我们提供任务援助。我们必须坚定信念，对胜利充满信心！毕竟，我们难道还有别的选择吗？$B$B那么，你愿意加入我们的行列吗？用你的力量来助我们一臂之力吧，$c！我的指挥官恩塔里在他的岗位上等待着你。
text.completion: 在联盟与部落双双失败之处，银色北伐军却成功了。然而，这份成功，却维持不了多久。我们对冰冠冰川的突破很快地就被强行阻止了。$B$B巫妖王的反击来的既快且狠。现在我们被迫采取守势。

english.title: Honor Above All Else
english.objectives: Report to Crusade Commander Entari at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
english.description: Long has been the path to our salvation, young $c. We have fought across continents, worlds even, to reach this point. Now we face our greatest challenge: the destruction of the Lich King and his Scourge.$B$BAlas, we fight this battle divided. The Horde and Alliance are in the throes of war and will lend us no support. We must remain unyielding in our cause! For what choice have we to do otherwise?$B$BDo you join the cause? Lend us your strength, $c! My commander, Entari, awaits you at his post.
english.completion: Where both the Alliance and the Horde failed, the Argent Crusade succeeded. The success, however, was short lived. Our breach into Icecrown was quickly - and with force - rebuffed.$B$BThe Lich King's retaliatory strike was immediate and brutal. Now we are on the defensive.

text.title: 雷蹄的记忆
text.objectives: 与浮冰深渊的迅矛酋长谈一谈，然后返回唐卡洛营地，向夏拉托尔复命。
text.description: 青铜龙族赐予我永生并指派我为历史的见证者，诺兹多姆也将知识之锤交给我保管。$B$B从知识之锤的反应来看，这里的时间流出现了偏差，而我们的职责就是让它恢复正常。$B$B我们必须找到错误的时间流节点。这里的西北方就是浮冰深渊，那里是唐卡洛战士的安息之地。我要你找到雷蹄的兄弟，迅矛酋长的灵魂。问问他还记不记得雷蹄与北风交战的场景。
text.progress: 你从迅矛酋长的灵魂那里听到了什么？
text.completion: 甚至连酋长都开始失去他的回忆了？历史就在我们的眼前被篡改，如果我们无法找出幕后的黑手，雷蹄所流传下来的一切都会永远消失。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。

english.title: Memories of Stormhoof
english.objectives: Speak with Chieftain Swiftspear in Frostfloe Deep, then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: When the bronze dragonflight gifted me with immortality and set me on the path of the witness, Nozdormu entrusted me with the Lorehammer.$B$BThe hammer's reaction to your findings means that time has gone awry here and it is our duty to restore the true timeline.$B$BWe must find it. To the northwest is Frostfloe Deep, ancient burial cave of the warriors of Tunka'lo. Seek out the spirit of Chieftain Swiftspear, Stormhoof's brother. Ask him what he remembers of his brother's battle against the North Wind.
english.completion: Even the chieftain is beginning to lose his memories? The past is being rewritten before our eyes and if we do not find out who is behind this, the entire legacy of Stormhoof could be lost forever.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.
english.objective1: Ask Chieftain Swiftspear about his memories

text.title: 时间的扰动
text.objectives: 使用酋长的图腾封闭4道浮冰裂隙，然后将图腾还给唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
text.description: 这里，唐卡洛战士的墓地，本来是一块远离元素侵扰的安宁之地。$B$B如今，浮冰深渊却被一股诡异的力量侵袭，正是这种异状打扰了安息的灵魂，令我的记忆变得模糊不清。$B$B我们的事迹与记忆开始逐渐从历史中消散。$B$B我活着的时候，这根图腾是我身份的象征。在我死后，它则是连接我和生者世界最后的媒介。我要你借助它的力量恢复墓地的宁静，然后将它带回唐卡洛营地。
text.progress: 你从陵墓里带回了什么？
text.completion: 酋长的魂魄要你带给我这个？$B$B<夏拉托尔检查着图腾。>$B$B啊，我了解他的意图了。他要你用图腾封闭深渊里的时间裂隙，是为了让我们了解时间线发生了什么事。多么睿智的迅矛酋长——即使在死后，仍然考虑着他的子民。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。

english.title: Distortions in Time
english.objectives: Use the Chieftain's Totem to close 4 Frostfloe Rifts, then bring the totem to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: This, the tomb of Tunka'lo's warriors, is supposed to be a serene place, free from the terror of the elements.$B$BFrostfloe Deep has been invaded by a strange force, one that disturbs the spirits of the fallen and blurs my memories of my own life.$B$BIt's as though our deeds and memories are being erased from history.$B$BIn life, this totem was a symbol of my authority. It is the last true link I have to this world. Take it, use it to restore calm to the tomb, and then return it to Camp Tunka'lo.
english.progress: What is it you have brought from the tomb?
english.completion: The chieftain's spirit told you to bring this to me?$b$b<Xarantaur examines the totem.>$b$bAh, I see what he intended. By telling you to use this totem to close the rifts in the deep, he has given us a clue as to what's happening to the timeline. A wise chieftain, this Swiftspear, watching over his people even in death.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 保卫前线基地
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川银色前线基地的北伐军领主达尔弗斯要求你杀死15只遗忘深渊蛛魔。
text.description: 我们坚持不了多久了，$g伙计:小姑娘。在我们打开突破口之后，天灾士兵就像开了闸的洪水一样涌了过来，真是铺天盖地！$B$B我们需要每一个人都拿起武器，抵挡天灾军团的进攻。去尽你的那份责任吧，朋友。尽可能多地干掉那些怪物！
text.progress: 别放弃，$N！
text.completion: 它们究竟有多少啊？我们杀掉的敌人已经足以填满十个墓地了，但他们还是一直出现。情况看来相当险峻，我的朋友。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色前线基地的北伐军领主达尔弗斯。

english.title: Defending The Vanguard
english.objectives: Crusader Lord Dalfors at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you kill 15 Forgotten Depths Nerubians.
english.description: We can't keep this pace up, $g lad:lass;. Once the breach was blown, the floodgates opened up. The Scourge have been pourin' through ever since with no end in sight!$B$BWe need every able bodied man and woman to help keep the tide of evil at bay. Get out there and do yer share, friend. Kill as many of those monsters as ye can!
english.progress: Don't give up, $N!
english.completion: How many of them could there possibly be? We've killed enough to fill ten graveyards and still they come. The situation looks grim, friend.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Lord Dalfors at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

text.title: 致命的剧毒
text.objectives: 冰冠冰川银色前线基地的古斯塔夫神父要求你交给他10个遗忘深渊毒囊。
text.description: 受伤士兵的数字一天天地增加，他们都受到了某种我们从未见过的毒素的侵袭。不管这些蛛魔的毒液是如何构成的，总之，它们非常致命，简直可以说是毫无清除的可能！就现在来说，我们唯一能做的只是减缓毒素在受害者体内的蔓延速度。但是我们一定要想出一个治疗办法来！$B$B转至西北方，到前线基地外的山谷中去，干掉一些遗忘深渊蛛魔，把它们的毒囊给我拿回来。
text.progress: 你带回那些蛛魔的毒囊了吗，$r？
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我立刻着手研究，希望很快就可以找到解药。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色前线基地的古斯塔夫神父。

english.title: Curing The Incurable
english.objectives: Father Gustav at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown has asked that you bring him 10 Forgotten Depths Venom Sacs.
english.description: The number of injured soldiers rises with each passing day. They are being stricken by some type of toxin that we have never before seen. Whatever it is that these Nerubians hold within their venom glands is lethal and incurable! So far we've only been able to slow down the poison flowing through the victim's bodies. We must devise a cure!$B$BVenture northwest to the valley outside of the Vanguard and slay the Forgotten Depths Nerubians. Recover their venom glands and bring them to me.
english.progress: Have you recovered the venom glands, $r?
english.completion: Thank you, $N. I will begin the tests on these samples immediately. It is my hope that a cure will be found soon.
english.completed: Return to Father Gustav at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

text.title: 完成订单
text.objectives: 将一颗玉髓石交给达拉然的提莫斯·琼斯。
text.description: 真高兴见到你！我必须尽快将一批炽热鹿牙雕像送到安德麦去，但是恰好缺少一颗玉髓石来完成最后一尊雕像的眼睛。$B$B给我弄一颗宝石来，这枚达拉然珠宝匠硬币就是你的了。
text.progress: 你弄到玉髓石没？
text.completion: 这是我答应要给你的达拉然珠宝匠硬币。我总是有订单要交，所以别忘了常来看看我缺些什么东西。
text.completed: 去达拉然找卡蒂亚珠宝店的提莫斯·琼斯。

english.title: Finish the Shipment
english.objectives: Bring a Chalcedony to Timothy Jones in Dalaran.
english.description: I'm glad you showed up!   A shipment of Glowing Ivory Figurines needs to go out to Undermine right now, and I am still short a Chalcedony to complete an eye for the last one.$B$BBring me one and a Dalaran Jeweler's token will be yours.
english.progress: Do you have the Chalcedony yet?
english.completion: Here is your Dalaran Jewelcrafter's Token as promised. I have new shipments going out all the time, check by from time to time to see what I need.
english.completed: Return to Timothy Jones at Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.

text.title: 地下大厅的深处
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你调查学徒奥斯特基格，弄清楚恐怖博士的计划。$B$B事成之后，击败学徒奥斯特基格，并回来向女巫汇报。
text.description: 在东北方的地下大厅深处，有一个名叫恐怖博士的科学怪人，他正在秘密策划一项与他的名字相符的行动。$B$B如你所知，那些战死沙场、而且没有利用价值的维库人都会变成“瓦古”。恐怖博士正是奉了巫妖王之命，对这种被称为“瓦古”的天灾士兵进行实验。$B$B我们必须阻止他的研究工作，可是我的占卜术却无法探明他的下落。好在恐怖博士有一名助手。$B$B我要你去调查他的学徒，并获取必要的情报。如果他有所察觉，你就打败他之后赶紧回来。
text.progress: 你还没完成我交付的工作。$B$B没完成之前别回来，否则有你好受！
text.completion: 真有趣。听起来你干得不错。让我惊讶的是，恐怖博士那家伙竟然让一个实验用的瓦古当他的助手。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找约尔达村的白骨女巫。
text.objective1: 调查学徒奥斯特基格并得到情报

english.title: Deep in the Bowels of The Underhalls
english.objectives: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has asked you to beat information out of Apprentice Osterkilgr concerning what Dr. Terrible is truly up to.$B$BYou are then to slay the apprentice.
english.description: Deep in the bowels of The Underhalls to the northeast, a mad scientist known as Dr. Terrible is up to something befitting his name.$B$BThe doctor has been given dispensation by the Lich King to perform experiments upon the vargul -- the vrykul who fall in battle and are found unworthy, and then turned into Scourge.$B$BWe must put an end to his work, but my auguries have been unable to find him. He does, however, have an assistant.$B$BBeat the information out of his apprentice, and then dispose of the body.
english.progress: You have not finished what I asked of you.$B$BPlease leave and do not return until you have done so or I will be very cross.
english.completion: Very interesting. It sounds to me that you handled that perfectly. I'm surprised that the doctor was using a vargul as an assistant given what he was working on.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Information beaten out of Apprentice Osterkilgr

text.title: 一加一大于二
text.objectives: 登上尼尔盖德并控制它。抵御来自恐惧大厅的居民的攻击，直到恐怖博士现身。$B$B操纵尼尔盖德杀死恐怖博士，然后返回约尔达村，向白骨女巫复命。
text.description: 打开书卷之后，你发现上面绘制着各种各样令人作呕的插图，它们就是被恐怖博士称为“终极武器”的丑陋怪物！$B$B很显然，这些嵌合怪的原型就是那个名叫尼尔盖德的血肉巨人，它静静地矗立在恐惧大厅的尽头。$B$B如果让巫妖王建造出这样一支军队，世界将面临毁灭的威胁。要阻止事态的恶化，唯一的办法就是杀死恐怖博士！$B$B也许在你控制血肉巨人之后，恐怖博士就会被迫现身？
text.progress: 你找到了博士的书，但是你没有用血肉巨人把他杀掉？$B$B在事情太迟之前快回去把他给杀掉！
text.completion: 你发现了博士的阴谋，并且制止了他。$B$B<被女妖所控制的女巫笑了笑，轻轻的把手放在你的肩膀上。>$B$B你狠狠地戳了巫妖王一记，但是我想我们还能做得更好。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找约尔达村的白骨女巫。

english.title: The Sum is Greater than the Parts
english.objectives: Mount and take control of Nergeld. Defend it from the denizens of the Hall of Horrors until Dr. Terrible shows himself.$B$BUse Nergeld to slay the doctor, and then return to The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village.
english.description: Opening the tome, you notice all manner of disgusting illustrations concerning the construction of what the doctor refers to as "the ultimate weapon"!$B$BClearly the prototype, Nergeld, is the massive flesh giant standing still at the end of the nearby Hall of Horrors.$B$BIf an army of those things were to be constructed, then it would mean doom. The only way to ensure that doesn't happen is to slay Dr. Terrible!$B$BPerhaps if you were to take control of the construct, the doctor would reveal himself?
english.progress: You recovered the doctor's tome, but you didn't finish him off using the flesh giant?$B$BGet back in there and kill him before it's too late!
english.completion: You discovered and put an end to the doctor's machinations.$B$B<The banshee-controlled witch smiles and places a large hand gently upon your shoulder.>$B$BThat's a fine poke in the eye for the Lich King, but I think we can do better.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

text.title: 如果还有幸存者……
text.objectives: 与冰冠冰川银色前线基地的本诺比奥斯谈一谈。
text.description: 穿越西面的回音谷和突破口，就是冰冠冰川的第一个天灾营地——天灾城。我们与天灾军团在那里进行了一场恶战，尽管消灭了大量的天灾士兵，但我们最终还是寡不敌众，被迫撤退。有许多士兵没能赶上大部队，落在了后面，至今生死不明。$B$B如果还有人活着的话，我们就必须想办法把他们救出来。青铜龙军团派来的盟友，始祖龙管理员本诺比奥斯就在这条通往东南方的道路的尽头。去找到他，寻求他的帮助。
text.completion: <本诺比奥斯点点头。>$B$B我会助你一臂之力。我们将并肩作战，对抗巫妖王与他的天灾军团。

english.title: If There Are Survivors...
english.objectives: Speak with Penumbrius at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
english.description: Across the Valley of Echoes, west of here, and through the Breach, is the first Scourge encampment in Icecrown known as Scourgeholme. We fought a good fight at Scourgeholme and killed many Scourge, but in the end we were forced to retreat. Many soldiers were left behind - their fate unknown.$B$BIf there are survivors, we must attempt a rescue. Directly down this southeastern path is Penumbrius, ally of the bronze dragonflight and caretaker of the proto-brood. Seek him out and ask for his assistance.
english.completion: <Penumbrius nods.>$B$BMy kin will help. Together we will battle the Lich King and his undead legions.

text.title: 空中救兵
text.objectives: 从天灾城营救3名被俘虏的银色北伐军士兵，把他们送往银色前线基地中心的医护所。完成任务之后，向大领主提里奥·弗丁复命。
text.description: 我们会尽全力协助你，$N。始祖龙愿意载你飞越突破口，把你送到天灾城里。尽你的全力营救每一位被困的北伐军士兵，然后立即把他们送回位于基地中央的前线基地医护所。$B$B从我身后的围栏里挑选一头银色天爪龙，马上出发吧！$B$B天灾城就在西北边，穿过回音谷和突破口就到了。
text.progress: 他们生还的机会正随着时间一点一滴地流逝。
text.completion: 阿尔萨斯……他鲁莽地发动攻击——如此的轻率又毫无戒备之心。这下我们已洞悉他的弱点了。$B$B<大领主提里奥·弗丁停顿片刻，陷入沉思之中。>$B$B我们必须加强防御，熬过即将到来的突袭。$B$B你熟悉火炮的操作吗，$N？
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色前线基地的大领主提里奥·弗丁。
text.objective1: 营救被俘虏的北伐军士兵

english.title: Into The Wild Green Yonder
english.objectives: Rescue 3 Captured Argent Crusaders from Scourgeholme and drop them off at the Vanguard Infirmary at the center of the Argent Vanguard. Report to Highlord Tirion Fordring should you succeed.
english.description: We will do all that we can to assist you, $N. The proto-brood have volunteered to fly you across the Breach and into Scourgeholme. Rescue any captured Argent Crusaders that you find. Return them immediately to the Vanguard Infirmary, located at the center of this base.$B$BChoose one of the Argent Skytalons in the pen behind me and go!$B$BScourgeholme is located northwest, across the Valley of Echoes, through the great Breach.
english.progress: With each minute that passes their chance of survival decreases.
english.completion: Arthas... He strikes recklessly - without care or caution. We have caught him off guard.$B$B<Highlord Tirion Fordring pauses, lost in thought for a moment.>$B$BWe will bolster our defenses and weather the storm.$B$BHow good are you with a cannon, $N?
english.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

text.title: 喂饱安格里姆
text.objectives: 让安格里姆吞食5条灵体冰虫，然后返回丹尼芬雷，向安格里姆的冰冻躯体复命。$b$b你必须转至上古寒冬山谷，对游荡的冰虫使用安格里姆之牙。一旦它们脱离肉体，就与灵体形态的冰虫进行战斗，直到它们变得虚弱。
text.description: 安格里姆的可怕贪欲堪称无以伦比。$B$B即使在死后，凝固在他脸上的神情也流露出极度饥饿的模样。只是看着他，就会让你觉得腹中空荡荡的。$B$B据说他生前什么都吃，但是从来没有真正吃饱过。你禁不住想，有没有可能让这位老国王吃饱呢？$B$B就在你脑海中闪过这个念头的时候，一颗巨大的牙齿从安格里姆嘴里滑落，在他的胡须上弹了一下，落在了你的手中。
text.completion: 当你将牙齿装回安格里姆的下颚，你发现你的努力，稍稍减轻了这位老国王的饥饿……尽管只是暂时的。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁丹尼芬雷找贪婪的安格里姆。

english.title: Feeding Arngrim
english.objectives: You are to feed Arngrim 5 Disembodied Jormungar, then return to Arngrim's frozen image in Dun Niffelem.$b$bYou must go to the Valley of Ancient Winters and use Arngrim's Tooth on the Roaming Jormungar there. Once they have become disembodied, you must fight them until they are weakened.
english.description: Arngrim's hunger was legendary.$b$bEven in death, his expression is one of famished yearning. You find that just looking at him is making your stomach growl.$b$bIt is said that throughout his life he was never truly sated, and that there was absolutely nothing he wouldn't eat. You wonder to yourself if there might be a way to feed the old king.$b$bNo sooner does the thought enter your mind than one of the massive frozen teeth falls from Arngrim's head, bounces off of his beard and lands in your hand.
english.completion: As you anchor the tooth in Arngrim's jaw, you get the impression that your efforts may have taken the edge off of the old king's hunger pangs... for now.
english.completed: Return to Arngrim the Insatiable at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 清算之战
text.objectives: 转至智慧神殿附近与托里姆碰面。然后向丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王汇报战斗的结果。
text.description: 洛肯杀害了我的妻子，让我的拥护者转而与我为敌。他夺走了我的一切，但是今天……一切都将改变。$b$b今天，我们将夺回曾经的圣地。今天……就是洛肯的死期。$B$B转至奥杜尔西南方的智慧神殿，到神殿附近的桥上与我碰面。无论如何，我要和洛肯做个了断。$B$B我要你见证这场复仇之战。你不要插手——这是私人恩怨。$B$B请你向冰霜巨人之王约库姆汇报战斗的结果。他是我的好朋友，他知道该怎么做。
text.progress: 啊，$N！很高兴见到你，小伙子。
text.completion: 不……这不可能……$B$B没人能在决斗中击败托里姆。巨人不能，野兽也不能……不可能有人！更不可能是他那个懦夫哥哥！$B$B我以先祖之名起誓……$B$B洛肯将为此付出代价！
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找丹尼芬雷的约库姆国王。

english.title: The Reckoning
english.objectives: Meet Thorim near the Temple of Wisdom.  Report the outcome of the fight to King Jokkum in Dun Niffelem.
english.description: Loken killed my wife, turned my followers and me against each other.  He took away everything I had, but today... that changes.$B$BToday we reclaim our sacred grounds.  Today... Loken dies.$B$BMeet me on the bridge near the Temple of Wisdom, just southwest of Ulduar.  I will finish this one way or the other.$B$BI need you there as a witness.  You will not aid me -- this is personal.$B$BAfter it's done, send word to Jokkum, King of the Frost Giants.  He's a good friend and will know what to do.
english.progress: Ach, $N!  It's good to see you, little one.
english.completion: No... it cannot be...$B$BNo one can defeat Thorim in single combat.  Not a giant, nor a beast... no one!  Especially not that coward of a brother of his.$B$BOn my forefathers' names, this I swear...$B$BLoken will pay for this!
english.completed: Return to King Jokkum at Dun Niffelem in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 错误的时间流
text.objectives: 对牦牛人的圣物使用知识之锤，让它与雷蹄生活的时间流实现同调。等它与6件雷蹄时代的圣物完成同调之后，回去向唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔复命。
text.description: 我们可以使用知识之锤修复损坏的时间流，但是必须首先找到历史是从哪儿开始被破坏的。$b$b从迅矛酋长提供的信息以及你在浮冰深渊的发现来看，时间流是在雷蹄死亡的时刻发生改变的。$B$B我要你转至营地北边的凛风洞窟，进入已经被北风的侍从破坏的墓地。知识之锤将与雷蹄时代的圣物产生反应，实现与正确时间流的同调。
text.progress: 你将知识之锤同调至雷蹄的时代了吗？
text.completion: <夏拉托尔收下了你手上的知识之锤。>$B$B我们终于在历史上正确标定了雷蹄的年代。根据这点，我们可以恢复时间线的历史了。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
text.objective1: 将知识之锤与雷蹄所在的时间同调

english.title: Where Time Went Wrong
english.objectives: Use the Lorehammer on Taunka Relics to attune it to the time of Stormhoof. Once it has been attuned to 6 relics from the time of Stormhoof, return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: The Lorehammer can help us correct the damage to the timeline, but only if we can discover where the history was originally corrupted.$B$BFrom Chieftain Swiftspear and your findings at Frostfloe Deep, we know that the change happened around the time of Stormhoof's death.$B$BNow, you must go to the Howling Hollow, north of the camp, and inspect the gravesites the North Wind's minions have already destroyed. The Lorehammer will react to artifacts from Stormhoof's era and attune itself to the proper time.
english.progress: Have you attuned the Lorehammer to the time period of Stormhoof?
english.completion: <Xarantaur accepts the Lorehammer from you.>$b$bAt last, we've pinpointed the time of Stormhoof in history. With this knowledge, we can restore the timeline.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 英雄的装备
text.objectives: 将雷蹄的长矛和雷蹄的锁甲交给唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。
text.description: 并不是营地中的所有记录都遭到了破坏。我的手下帮我找到了那些能够反映真实时间流的记录。$B$B这些证据表明，雷蹄和村落中的长者一样，被埋葬在北边的凛风洞窟底层。$B$B北风的侍从早已将墓地破坏殆尽，还夺走了墓穴主人的陪葬品。我要你转至凛风洞窟，看看能否从那些强盗手中夺回雷蹄的武器和盔甲。
text.progress: 你找到雷蹄的长矛与锁甲了吗？
text.completion: 你果然没有辜负我的期望，$N。有了它们，我就可以使用知识之锤将你送回过去，去北风开始破坏时间线的时候。这是我们纠正此地历史的唯一机会。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。

english.title: The Hero's Arms
english.objectives: Recover Stormhoof's Spear and Stormhoof's Mail and return them to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: Not all of the camp's records have yet been corrupted. My staff has helped me to find those records which reflect the true timeline.$B$BThey agree that Stormhoof was given a burial of honor among the village elders on the bottom level of the Howling Hollow, to the north.$B$BMost of the graves there have already been destroyed, their contents taken as trophies by the North Wind's subjects. Go to the hollow and see if you can recover Stormhoof's spear and armor from the scions of storm who have claimed them.
english.progress: Have you found Stormhoof's weapon and armor?
english.completion: We are fortunate that you have recovered these intact, $N. With them, I can use the Lorehammer to send you back in time, to where the North Wind started to corrupt the true timeline. It's the only way we can restore the true history of this place.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 维拉努斯
text.objectives: 风暴神殿的托里姆要你从布伦希尔达村附近的峭壁上取回5枚规模始祖龙卵。
text.description: 要想对洛肯的军队发动攻击，我就必须找到可以让我灵活行动的方法。$B$B多年前，我将飞龙坐骑维拉努斯放归了大自然。她曾伴我征战四方，如今早已重登族群女王的宝座。$B$B我觉得我们很难找到她，不过有个法子或许能奏效。维拉努斯早已过了繁殖的年龄，但是她依然待在空空如也的巢穴里。这位名义上的族群女王以此维系着她高贵的尊严。$B$B从布伦希尔达村附近的其它巢穴中取回一些小龙卵，我再告诉你接下来要怎么做。
text.progress: 你弄到蛋了吗，$N？
text.completion: 对了……这就对了。希望我的计划可行，$N。$B$B维拉努斯蛮强悍的——我才不会为了头小龙，费心安排这一切。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找风暴神殿的托里姆。

english.title: Veranus
english.objectives: Thorim, at the Temple of Storms, wants you to obtain 5 Small Proto-Drake Eggs from the peaks near Brunnhildar Village.
english.description: If I'm to launch an attack against my brother's army, I'm going to need some way to get around.$B$BI released my riding drake back into the wild years ago.  Veranus was magnificent.  The leader of her own brood -- to whom she has now returned.$B$BFinding her will be hard, but perhaps there's a way.  She keeps her old empty nest out of pure pride.  She's a broodmother in name only, for she is beyond the age of breeding.$B$BBring me small eggs from the other nests near Brunnhildar.  I think I've an idea.
english.progress: Did you obtain the eggs, $N?
english.completion: Yes... these will do.  Let us hope my plan works, $N.$B$BVeranus is a great drake.  I'd hate to have to settle for a lesser one.
english.completed: Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in Storm Peaks.

text.title: 侵犯领土
text.objectives: 将偷来的始祖龙卵放置在母龙之巢的顶部，然后返回风暴神殿向托里姆复命。
text.description: 维拉努斯是我见过的最高傲的野兽。她仍然待在旧时的巢穴里，确保它不被年轻的始祖龙霸占。$B$B将你取回的龙卵放入她的巢穴。喏，就在东南方的那座小山峰上。$B$B维拉努斯见到这样的场景一定会勃然大怒，希望我能在她杀死你之前控制住她。希望如此吧。
text.progress: 干得好，$N！
text.completion: 很高兴看到你回来。这表示我已经开始转运了……这都要归功于你，我的朋友。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找风暴神殿的托里姆。

english.title: Territorial Trespass
english.objectives: Place the Stolen Proto-Dragon Eggs on top of the Broodmother's Nest and return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms.
english.description: Veranus is proud like no other beast I've known.  She still keeps her old nest and makes sure none of the younger proto-drakes takes it over.$B$BTake the eggs you've collected and place them on her nest.  You'll find it atop a small peak, directly southeast of here.$B$BI should be able to get control of her before she kills you in a fit of rage.  Hopefully.
english.completion: It's good to have my old friend back.  It appears that my luck is finally starting to change... and it's all thanks to you, little friend.
english.completed: Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in Storm Peaks.

text.title: 空中侦察
text.objectives: 卡尔维特教授要你飞往湖边着陆场，与飞行员维克谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你帮维斯雷修好了那架飞行器。$B$B你愿意再帮我们一个忙吗？西北方有一股不寻常的气流袭来。我已经指派了飞行员维克去侦察情况，不过他恐怕还需要一名副驾驶员。$B$B如果你觉得自己能胜任的话，就飞往湖边着陆场去找他吧。哦，记得告诉他，是我派你去的。
text.completion: 教授派你来找我？好吧。

english.title: Aerial Surveillance
english.objectives: Professor Calvert wants you to take the flight to Lakeside Landing and speak with Pilot Vic there.
english.description: You did a good job helping Wes with getting that flying machine back up and running.$B$BIf you'd like to help us further, there is an unusual weather pattern coming in from the northwest.  I have a pilot ready to work for me, but I'm afraid he needs a copilot.$B$BIf you think you're up to it, you can take the flight to Lakeside Landing.  Tell Vic I sent you.

text.title: 寻找幸存者
text.objectives: 帮助扎克·沃布维奇完成试飞。
text.description: 格莱奇·菲兹巴克想要用我的飞行器去寻找探险队的幸存者。她似乎觉得他们是被当成囚犯关在了北面的村庄里。$B$B现在唯一的问题是，我没有副驾驶员。如果你愿意帮这个忙，我很愿意教你一两招。$b$b你觉得怎么样，$N？就这么说定咯？
text.progress: 是，$N？
text.completion: 不错……还不错！嗯，我想你够格在这种天气中飞行了。$B$B你飞得就像我认识的每个飞行员一样好。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找伯尔瀑布的“诚实的”麦克斯。

english.title: Looking for Survivors
english.objectives: Help Zak Wobblesprocket complete the Test Flight.
english.description: Gretchen Fizzlespark wants to use my flying machine to look for survivors from her expedition.  Apparently she thinks they're being held prisoner in the village to the north.$B$BThe only problem is I don't have a co-pilot.  If you're willing to take it on, I'd be more than happy to teach you a move or two.$B$BWhat do you say, $N?  Deal?
english.completed: Return to "Honest" Max at Bor's Fall in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 失踪的猎人
text.objectives: 转至格罗玛什坠毁点东南边的基莫拉克之巢，寻找猎户瓦尔兹。
text.description: 如果我把你派去独闯狼穴，但是不告诉你我们上次派去的人至今未归的话，我会为此感到良心不安的。$B$B我们已经做了最坏的打算，不过没准他还活着呢？如果你能把他带回来的话，我们会非常感激——猎户瓦尔兹是我们的最后一名猎人了。
text.progress: 噢，老兄……这痛苦……简直叫人吃不消。
text.completion: 我伤得如此重，老兄。不知道熬不熬得过去？

english.title: The Missing Tracker
english.objectives: Look for Tracker Val'zij inside Gimorak's Den, southeast of the Grom'arsh Crash Site.
english.description: I can't in good conscience send you to the worg cave without warning you that the previous person we sent there hasn't returned.$B$BWe're prepared for the worst, but perhaps there's a chance that he's alive.  We'd appreciate it if you helped him return -- Tracker Val'zij is one of the only hunters we have.
english.completion: This hurts bad, mon. Don't know if I'm gonna make it.

text.title: 洞穴中的药品
text.objectives: 基莫拉克之巢的猎户瓦尔兹希望你去收集1个冰虫毒腺和8只洞穴蘑菇。
text.description: 终于看到一张友善的面孔了，或许也是我所看到的最后一张面孔呢。$B$B我不小心被冰虫蜇了，毒素流遍了我的全身。我可以感觉到自己的整个身体都在逐渐失去知觉。$B$B我需要一只冰虫的毒腺来制造解毒剂，另外还需要一些生长在这里的洞穴蘑菇……它们可以延缓毒素的蔓延。$B$B快一点，拜托了。我坚持不了多久。
text.progress: 你……回来了，朋友？
text.completion: 感谢你，我的朋友。我可以见到明天的太阳了。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找基莫拉克之巢的猎户瓦尔兹。

english.title: Cave Medicine
english.objectives: Tracker Val'zij, at Gimorak's Den, wants you to obtain 1 Jormungar Toxin Gland and 8 Cave Mushrooms.
english.description: It's good to see a friendly face.  Might be the last one I see.$B$BOne of those jormungar stung me with some sort of toxin before I managed to get away.  I can feel my whole body getting numb, mon.$B$BI'm going to need a toxin gland to make an antidote.  I will also need some of the cave mushrooms that grow here... they'll slow the toxin down.$B$BHurry, please.  I don't have much time.
english.progress: You back, mon?
english.completion: I thank you, mon. I might live another day now.
english.completed: Return to Tracker Val'zij at Gimorak's Den in the Storm Peaks.

text.title: 有仇必报
text.objectives: 猎户瓦尔兹要求你去杀死基莫拉克之巢里的基莫拉克。
text.description: 我应该坚持得住，$N。不过，我还需要你帮我一个忙。$B$B如果我的风蛇希尔莎没有被那头极其凶残的座狼杀死，我是绝对不会被这些虫子暗算的。$B$B不用担心我，如果你能除掉那头座狼，我会感觉更好的。你可以在洞穴深处找到它。
text.progress: 你找到那卑鄙的畜牲了吗，$N？
text.completion: 我感觉好多了，不知道是因为解药，还是因为那个畜生得到报应的消息。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找基莫拉克之巢的猎户瓦尔兹。

english.title: There's Always Time for Revenge
english.objectives: Tracker Val'zij wants you to slay Gimorak inside Gimorak's Den.
english.description: I should manage for now, $N.  There is one favor I'd like to ask, though.$B$BI would never had fallen to one of these worms, but my wind serpent, Heesha, was killed by the meanest worg I've seen in some time.$B$BDon't worry about me now, I'll feel better when that worg is breathing no more.  You should find him deeper in the cave.
english.completion: I'm already feeling much better, mon. Not sure if it's the antidote or the news of that filthy worg getting what he deserved.
english.completed: Return to Tracker Val'zij at Gimorak's Den in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 造物者圣台
text.objectives: 转至丹尼芬雷西北方的造物者圣台，在该区域的东南部边缘寻找托里姆。
text.description: 是时候了，$N！我已经做好了与洛肯正面交锋的准备。$B$B让我们向造物者圣台前进，迎战我兄弟的部队。那个蠢货会后悔的！
text.completion: 我们到了，$N。我兄弟的部队今天就得学会战败的意义。

english.title: The Terrace of the Makers
english.objectives: Find Thorim at the southeastern edge of the Terrace of the Makers, just northwest of Dun Niffelem.
english.description: It is time, $N.  I am prepared to face Loken now.$B$BLet us make our way to the Terrace of the Makers and face my brother's forces.  The fool will regret ever crossing me.
english.completion: We're here, $N.  My brother's forces will learn the meaning of defeat today.

text.title: 改变风向
text.objectives: 使用知识之锤回到过去，以雷蹄的身份挑战北风。雷蹄倒下之后会掉落元素愤怒号角，届时你必须使用元素愤怒号角击败北风，然后返回唐卡洛营地，向夏拉托尔复命。
text.description: 万事俱备，我们可以纠正北风和他的侍从犯下的错误了。你已经将知识之锤与雷蹄以及他生活的时间流实现了同调。$B$B现在，我要你带上它转至西北方的平原上的生命神殿，在那里使用知识之锤，以雷蹄的身份挑战北风。你要记住，为了让时间流恢复正常，雷蹄必须在北风变得虚弱时死去。$B$B接着，你要找到并使用元素愤怒号角，消灭北风。
text.progress: 你完成任务了吗？时间线回复原状了吗？
text.completion: 你今天的所作所为将使雷蹄与其事迹永载青史。同时你也让自己留名于于艾泽拉斯史册之中。我会记住你并记载你不朽的成就。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找唐卡洛营地的夏拉托尔。

english.title: Changing the Wind's Course
english.objectives: Use the Lorehammer to travel back in time and face the North Wind as Stormhoof. When Stormhoof falls and drops the Horn of Elemental Fury, use it to finish off the North Wind, and then return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo.
english.description: At last, we have all that we need to right the wrongs of the North Wind and its followers. You have attuned the Lorehammer to Stormhoof's time and his persona.$B$BTake the hammer again, head to the Temple of Life in the plains to the northwest. Use the hammer to assume the role of Stormhoof. Face the North Wind as Stormhoof, but realize that for the timeline to be restored, Stormhoof must die as the North Wind weakens.$B$BThen, you must find and use the Horn of Elemental Fury to destroy the North Wind.
english.progress: Have you done it? Is the true timeline restored?
english.completion: What you have done today will ensure that Stormhoof and his story will never be forgotten. As well, you have written yourself into the pages of Azeroth's history. I will remember and record your accomplishments for all eternity.
english.completed: Return to Xarantaur at Camp Tunka'lo in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 瓦古的复仇
text.objectives: 地下大厅的贝索德·菲格要你扔出他的剑，在受难之环中挑战并杀死伊尔斯卡领主。
text.description: 我一直在向利剑女神祈祷，希望有一位英雄能挺身而出，帮助我消灭仇敌。$B$B伊尔斯卡领主必须为他的罪行付出代价！$B$B我曾是强大的乌弗朗领主麾下的第一勇士，如今却只残留一具空洞的躯壳。在瓦哈拉斯的战斗中，伊尔斯卡利用黑暗的魔法暗中捣鬼，让我输掉了战斗，导致我沦为现在的模样。$B$B伊尔斯卡领主和他手下的勇士就在受难之环中。代表我向他发起挑战并击败他。$B$B让他明白我承受了怎样的痛苦！
text.progress: 我感觉到你尚未击败伊尔斯卡领主，有什么困难吗？
text.completion: 谢谢你，$C……谢谢你！$B$B让我沦落至斯的懦夫，将和我一样，永远地腐朽，这个讯息令我感到莫大的满足。$B$B现在，马上离开，在我还没失去控制并把你大卸八块之前。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川地下大厅的贝索德·菲格。
text.objective1: 使用贝索德的剑发起挑战

english.title: Revenge for the Vargul
english.objectives: Bethod Feigr in The Underhalls wants you to throw down his sword to challenge Thane Illskar and then kill him in The Circle of Suffering.
english.description: I've been praying to The Lady of the Sword for one to come and strike down my enemy. Thane Illskar must pay for what he did to me!$B$BI was the champion of Thane Ufrang the Mighty. During my fight for ascendance in Valhalas, Illskar sabotaged me with dark magic, causing me to lose and be reduced to this.$B$BThe thane and his champions can be found below in The Circle of Suffering. Challenge him on my behalf. Defeat him.$B$BMake him know the suffering that I know!
english.progress: I sense that you haven't yet defeated Thane Illska. Does something stay your hand?
english.completion: Thank you, $c... thank you!$B$BYou've given me the satisfaction of knowing that the coward who made me into this will rot for all eternity as surely as I will.$B$BNow leave before I lose control of myself and cut you down.
english.completed: Return to Bethod Feigr at the Underhalls in Icecrown.

text.title: 终极运输方案
text.objectives: 与莉吉特谈一谈，使用她的D16推进运载器进入风暴峭壁的深处。
text.description: 看来……看来我们是别想在这层层叠叠的群山中找到一个合适的定居点了。$B$B相信我，我不是那种轻言放弃的人……但是被冻住的引擎、讨厌的维库女人、飞来飞去的恶龙和乱七八糟的其它怪物，换了是你，你能怎么办？$B$B不过，不要慌张！我只是说我们找不到一个合适的定居点，但这并不意味着我们不能送你一程……单线旅行总是很简单的。$B$B<莉吉特指了指附近的火箭。>
text.completion: <欧拉特眨了眨眼。>$B$B那看起来还真痛。不过可真是华丽的登场。$B$B你是要来帮我们找条路进入冰冠冰川的吗？如你所见，我们首趟旅途下场并不太好。我想我们最好快点离开这个地方，好另建据点。

english.title: When All Else Fails
english.objectives: Speak to Ricket to make use of Ricket's D16 Propelled Delivery Device to enter further into Storm Peaks.
english.description: So...  so I don't think we're going to be getting a good foothold in those mountains.$B$BTrust me, I'm not one to give up easily... but between freezing engines, nasty vrykul women, territorial dragon want-to-bes and the half a dozen other nasties settled in the area, this just ain't happening.$B$BDon't let that dissuade you though! Just because we can't get a foothold doesn't mean we won't get you there... one-way trips are pretty simple when you get down to it.$B$B<Ricket nods at some nearby rockets.>
english.completion: <Olut winces.>$b$bThat looked painful. It was a pretty grand entrance though.$b$bAre you here to help us find a path into Icecrown? As you can see, our first foray in that direction didn't end too admirably. I'm thinking we might be better off breaching the place from another side.

text.title: 为荣耀而战
text.objectives: 与布伦希尔达村的女巫洛莉拉谈一谈。
text.description: 就这样吧。我会好好照顾你的熊，你不会再需要它了。接下来，你将迎接驭龙赛的挑战。$B$B和你的朋友们说再见吧，尽量把事情都交代好。至于你是获胜归来还是一去不复返……就全看你自己的了。
text.completion: 你居然一路走到了这里。我真的没想到你会在海德尼尔中晋升得如此之快。

english.title: Prepare for Glory
english.objectives: Speak to Lok'lira the Crone in Brunnhildar Village.
english.description: This is it then.  I'll take care of your bear now, you won't be needing her.  The great Drakkensryd will be your next challenge.$B$BSay goodbye to your friends and leave your affairs in order, for you will return victorious... or you won't return at all.
english.completion: You've really made it this far.  Never would I have thought you'd progress so quickly among the hyldnir.

text.title: 洛莉拉的离别赠礼
text.objectives: 与布伦希尔达村的仲裁者格蕾塔谈一谈。
text.description: 你真是个得力的好帮手，$N。现在来面对真正的考验吧。你需要技术、勇气和一点点幸运。$B$B<洛莉拉把一小簇头发贴在你的身上。>$B$B祝你好运，我的姐妹。去找仲裁者格蕾塔谈谈吧，她会告诉你接下来要怎么做的。
text.completion: 你准备好要出发了吗，姐妹？出发了便无路可退。

english.title: Lok'lira's Parting Gift
english.objectives: Speak to Gretta the Arbiter in Brunnhildar Village.
english.description: You've been a great ally, $N.  Now comes your true test.  You will need skill, courage and a little luck.$B$B<Lok'lira attaches a thin strand of hair to yours.>$B$BYou cannot fail now sister.  Speak to Gretta the Arbiter.  She'll see you on your way.
english.completion: Are you ready to ride, sister?  There is no coming back.

text.title: 证明价值
text.objectives: 布莉亚娜希望你转至布伦希尔达村，与艾丝崔·约利塔尔谈一谈。
text.description: 你成功通过了许多人都无法通过的考验。这究竟是你的力量、勇气还是运气的缘故，我们不得而知。$B$B返回村庄，去找艾丝崔·约利塔尔。把你所取得的成就告诉她。不过我必须提醒你，她并不是那么容易亲近的。
text.progress: 怎么了，我的姐妹？
text.completion: 所以，我的姐妹，你认为完成几件再平常不过的杂活，就能成为女中豪杰？$B$B你该知道……

english.title: Deemed Worthy
english.objectives: Brijana wants you to go to Brunnhildar Village and speak with Astrid Bjornrittar.
english.description: You have succeeded where many have failed, sister. Whether it be by strength and courage or mere luck remains to be seen.$b$bGo back to the village and seek out Astrid Bjornrittar. Tell her of your accomplishments. But be warned. She is not easily impressed.
english.completion: So, sister, you think that completing a few simple chores makes you a heroine?$b$bYou shall learn....

text.title: 骨肉相残
text.objectives: 托里姆希望你能倾听他的故事。
text.description: 西芙？真的是你吗？$B$B哦？怎么是个$r？刚才我还以为……$b$b够了！我心爱的西芙……她的幻象折磨我实在太久了。是时候为她报仇、以荣耀来纪念她了。$B$B我的兄弟必须付出代价！
text.progress: 听到我说的话了吗，$r？
text.completion: 现在你稍微了解到这片土地……我的土地的历史。我要求你协助我拨乱反正。
text.completed: 去风暴峭壁找风暴神殿的托里姆。
text.objective1: 聆听托里姆讲述他的往事

english.title: Sibling Rivalry
english.objectives: Thorim wants you to listen to his story.
english.description: Sif? Is it truly you?$b$bNo? A $r? But for a moment....$b$bEnough of this! The visions of my Sif have tormented me for far too long. It is time for me to avenge her, and to bring honor to her memory.$b$bMy brother must pay!
english.progress: Hear my words, $r.
english.completion: You now know a bit of the history of this land... my land.$b$bI call upon you to assist me in setting these wrongs to right.
english.completed: Return to Thorim at the Temple of Storms in The Storm Peaks.

text.title: 勇气的传说
text.objectives: 北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁要你转至冰冠冰川东北部的沉默墓地，寻找战斗英雄布雷登布莱德的下落。从空中向下看去，他的篝火堆应该是最显眼的指示物。
text.description: 你大概已经听说了我们对那位失踪英雄的溢美之词。$B$B勇敢的北伐军战士布雷登布莱德曾经在破碎前线协助我们的攻势，不料天灾军团发动了一场猛烈的进攻。部队伤亡惨重，许多士兵都在混乱中失散了。布雷登布莱德不仅安然无恙地回来了，还从成堆的尸体里救出了超过一打的战友。$B$B但是在那之后，人们就再也没有见过他。有人看见他朝东北方的沉默墓地去了。你去把他找回来吧，我要表彰他的英雄事迹。
text.completion: 退后！小心点！我已经被瘟疫给控制了，但是我不会让它传染到你身上的。

english.title: A Tale of Valor
english.objectives: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you locate the hero, Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil, in northeast Icecrown.  His fire pit will likely be the most obvious indication of his location from the air.
english.description: Perhaps you've heard the praises for our missing hero?$B$BCrusader Bridenbrad was in the Broken Front aiding the attack against the Scourge when the undead army came down upon them. The many men of that allied force scattered, but Bridenbrad alone returned and dragged more than a dozen men to safety, one by one through the carnage.$B$B$C, he has not returned since. He was spotted heading to the far northeast, towards the Silent Vigil. Bring him back to me that I might honor him for his valor.
english.completion: Back! Careful! The plague has gripped me and I'll not see it spread to you nor anyone else.

enders.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 把它们打下来！
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的跳跃者要你使用尤顿海姆速射鱼叉炮，击落15头尤顿海姆始祖龙以及它们的骑手。
text.description:
维库人凭借始祖龙骑兵和鱼叉炮，在尤顿海姆构筑了固若金汤的防御体系。他们将这些防御设施集中部
署在尤顿海姆最为薄弱的北面和西面。$B$B我们正好可以利用他们的防御设施来对付他们！$B$B<跳跃者用他的独眼死死地盯着你，发出邪恶的笑声。>$B$B转至西南方的瓦哈拉斯，登上维库人搭建在悬崖上的平台，随意控制一尊鱼叉炮，击落那些始祖龙和它们的骑手！
text.progress: 啧啧……你还没射下今天应有的配额！
text.completion: 你是真正的王牌，$N！你明天可以再回来一回吗？我相信一定有更多淘气的小始祖龙等着你给它个痛快。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找暗影拱顶的跳跃者。
text.objective1: 击落尤顿海姆的始祖龙以及它们的骑手

english.title: Shoot 'Em Up
english.objectives: The Leaper at The Shadow Vault wants you to use a Jotunheim Rapid-Fire Harpoon to shoot down 15 Jotunheim Proto-Drakes and their riders.
english.description: Jotunheim has aerial defenses, both in terms of proto-drake riders and harpoon guns. They've concentrated these on their northern and western facings where they are most vulnerable.$B$BLet's use their defenses against them!$B$B<The Leaper pierces you with his single eye and cackles maniacally.>$B$BTake control of a harpoon gun on the platforms that overhang the cliffs on either side of Valhalas to the southwest. Take out the proto-drakes and their riders. Shoot 'em up!
english.progress: Tsk, tsk... you haven't shot down your fair share of proto-drakes today!
english.completion: You are a true champion for the cause, $N!$B$BWon't you please come speak to me again tomorrow? I'm certain that there will be more of those nasty proto-drakes to shoot down.
english.completed: Return to The Leaper at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Jotunheim Proto-Drakes & their riders shot down

text.title: 冷锋逼近
text.objectives: 转至冰冠冰川的银色前线基地，向攻城大师菲斯克报到。
text.description: 死亡的寒意在西方翻腾，意图将我们的心和灵魂都冻结在这片荒野之中，要我们臣服于那黑暗的君主。我们要反抗到底！$B$B备战工作已经展开。到前门向攻城大师菲斯克报告，接受他指派给你的任务吧。
text.completion: 我们动作得快点，否则就会被天灾军团排山倒海的攻势淹没！我们已经没有时间构筑工事了，$r。你就直接投入战斗，并且祈求上帝的眷顾吧。

english.title: A Cold Front Approaches
english.objectives: Report to Siegemaster Fezzik at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.
english.description: The chill of death stirs in the west, threatening to freeze our hearts and souls to this wasteland and bind us to its dark master. We will stand and we will fight!$B$BThe preparations have begun. Report to Siegemaster Fezzik at the front gate for your assignment.
english.completion: We must be quick or face being overtaken by the Scourge! There's really no time for instructions, $r. You're just going to have to jump in and hope for the best.

text.title: 维尔喜欢火焰！
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的劣尸维尔要你偷得一头约尔达始祖龙，用它焚毁尤顿海姆的8幢维库人建筑物。$B$B不过，你无法焚毁坚固的巴拉加德堡垒。
text.description: 维尔喜欢火焰！维尔喜欢始祖龙！$B$B<这个憎恶兴奋地拍着双手。>$b$b$N，你去尤顿海姆，从约尔达村偷一条漂亮的始祖龙吧。让始祖龙喷出的烈焰在尤顿海姆燃起大火！
text.progress: 什么？暗邪还没看到华丽的烟火秀！$B$B$N回去，然后制造更多火光！
text.completion: 嘿嘿！$N真是始祖龙神偷。$B$B你明天再回来嘛，咱们可以制造更华丽的烟火秀！
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找暗影拱顶的劣尸维尔。

english.title: Vile Like Fire!
english.objectives: Vile at The Shadow Vault wants you to steal a Njorndar Proto-Drake and use it to set fire to 8 vrykul buildings in the greater Jotunheim region.$B$BBalargarde Fortress, due to its nature, cannot be set ablaze.
english.description: Vile like fire! Vile like proto-drakes!$B$B<The abomination claps its hands excitedly.>$B$BLittle $N go to Jotunheim and steal a pretty proto-drake in Njorndar Village. Make proto-drake make pretty fires on Jotunheim buildings!
english.progress: What? Vile not see lots of fire!!!$B$B$N, go back and make more fire!
english.completion: Yay, yay! $N is best proto-drake stealer.$B$BYou come back tomorrow and we make more fire!!!
english.completed: Return to Vile at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 弥留的英雄
text.objectives: 返回北伐军之峰，将北伐军战士布雷登布莱德的情况告诉大领主提里奥·弗丁。
text.description: 我知道你为什么来找我……是他们派你来的吧，但是我不能跟你回去。我感染了亡灵的瘟疫，不能将这厄运带给我身边的人。对，我要留在这里。$B$B唯一让我恐惧的是，当死亡降临时，我就会变成一个亡灵生物。我并不惧怕死亡本身，但是一想到要沦为叛徒阿尔萨斯的仆从，我就感到无比厌恶。$B$B你走吧……让他们别再派人来找我了。如果我把瘟疫传染给了别人，那我就万死莫赎了。
text.completion: 布雷登布莱德染上了瘟疫？我简直不能想象，对一个终身奉献给圣光之途的英雄来说，还有什么比这更悲惨的命运。更糟的是我们竟然无计可施，只能眼睁睁地看他死去。$B$B不，亡灵不是他的归途。我们应该想办法拯救他。

english.title: A Hero Remains
english.objectives: Bring news of Crusader Bridenbrad's fate to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.
english.description: I know why you've come... they've sent you to bring me back, but that cannot happen. I carry the plague of undeath, $c, and I'll not share my fate with those near me. No, I shall stay here.$B$BMy only regret lies in what I may become when death grips me. I do not fear death itself, but I loathe to consider serving the traitor, Arthas.$B$BLeave me... and see to it that no one else comes looking. You would do me a great disservice if you were to expose anyone to the plague that I carry.
english.completion: Bridenbrad has contracted the plague? I cannot imagine a worse fate for one who has devoted his life to the ways of light, nor can I fathom leaving him to die without lifting a finger to help.$B$BNo, undeath shall not be his fate. We shall find a way to aid this hero.

starters.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 守护者的帮助
text.objectives: 北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁要你去和大德鲁伊莉琳德拉谈一谈，请她送你去月光林地。抵达月光林地后，与守护者雷姆洛斯谈一谈。
text.description: 在这个世界上有一种存在，他们不受肉体凡胎的限制，能控制各种能量——恢复的能量、生命的能量和圣光的能量。布雷登布莱德绝不是普通人……他身上闪耀着勇气和忠诚的光辉。我们只能希望有这样的存在来帮助他，将他从比死亡更可怕的命运中拯救出来。$B$B去找银色前线基地中的大德鲁伊莉琳德拉谈一谈……请她送你去月光林地，向守护者雷姆洛斯求助吧。
text.completion: 你好，孩子。$B$B我了解提里奥的请求也相信他的决断，我们将会尽力帮助这位北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。你的请求并非易事……

english.title: The Keeper's Favor
english.objectives: Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle has requested that you secure passage from Arch Druid Lilliandra and speak to Keeper Remulos in Moonglade.
english.description: There are those of this world that tap into power unrestricted by the bounds of our mortal frames - powers of restoration, powers of life, and powers of light.  And Bridenbrad, this is no ordinary man... his valor and devotion shine through. We can only hope that one of these beings will intervene and bring this hero back from a fate worse than death.$B$BGo now and speak to Arch Druid Lilliandra in the Argent Vanguard... request passage to Moonglade and seek the aid of Keeper Remulos.
english.completion: Hello child.$B$BI understand Tirion's request and trust in his judgment, we will see what we can do for this Crusader Bridenbrad. What you ask is no simple task - the Scourge are not of this world, and many have failed in attempting to strip their corruption over the years.$B$BIn a being of nobility and light, all is not without hope.

text.title: 翡翠噩梦中的希望
text.objectives: 月光林地的守护者雷姆洛斯要你进入翡翠梦境，获取3枚翡翠橡果。$B$B跨出雷姆洛斯神殿的范围就可以回到艾泽拉斯世界。
text.description: 我们需要的东西只有在翡翠梦境才能找到……那是一种蕴含着强效恢复魔法的橡果。在这片神圣的林地里，许多地方都与翡翠梦境紧密相连，我的神殿也是其中之一。$B$B我要把你送入梦境去收集一些橡果。但是你也要做好准备，因为以这样的方式进入梦境是很危险的，你很可能被梦魇包围。$B$B你要赶快拿到橡果，然后跨出我的神殿，或者打自己一拳，这样就可以返回我们的世界了。
text.progress: 见到你安然无恙真好。你取得翡翠橡果了吗？
text.completion: 干得好，年轻人。
text.completed: 去月光林地找月神湖的守护者雷姆洛斯。

english.title: Hope Within the Emerald Nightmare
english.objectives: Keeper Remulos at Moonglade has instructed you to enter the emerald dream and recover 3 Emerald Acorns.$B$BLeave the vicinity of the Shrine of Remulos to return to Azeroth.
english.description: What we need exists only in the emerald dream... acorns that are infused with a powerful restorative magic. Many places in this sacred glade are closely tied with the dream, and my shrine is among them.$B$BI will send you into the dream to recover some of these acorns. Be prepared though $c, for this method of entering the dream is dangerous, and it is very likely you will be beset by nightmares.$B$BRecover a few acorns quickly, and then depart from my shrine or pinch yourself to return to our world.
english.progress: It is good to see that you are safe. Have you recovered the acorns?
english.completion: Excellent work, young one.
english.completed: Return to Keeper Remulos at the Shrine of Remulos in Moonglade.

text.title: 雷姆洛斯的恩赐
text.objectives: 将翡翠橡果交给冰冠冰川沉默墓地的北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。
text.description: 我会打开传送门，将你送回冰冠冰川的大德鲁伊身边。我祝福你和那位北伐军圣骑士，希望这颗橡果可以净化他，将他从瘟疫中解救出来。$B$B再见，$r。
text.progress: 你好，$C。我就知道你会回来，尽管我已警告你，但我很高兴你听从了我的话，不让其它人暴露于染病的风险之中。$B$B你为什么回来呢？
text.completion: 提里奥派你去找雷姆洛斯？我……我简直感动得不能自己。凡人实在不值得获得如此强大的协助，无论是多么尊贵，多么无私的人。你真是个好人，为了我跋涉了那么长的距离。请接受我由衷地谢意。$B$B植下翡翠橡果吧—— 我准备好了。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找沉默墓地的北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。

english.title: The Boon of Remulos
english.objectives: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown with the Emerald Acorn.
english.description: I shall open a portal to take you back to the druid that brought you here. You and your crusader have my well wishes. I hope that this acorn is able to purify your crusader and save him from the wretched fate of the plague.$B$BFarewell, $r.
english.progress: Well met, $c. I knew that you would return, despite my warnings, but I'm pleased that you heeded my desire to not risk anyone else.$B$BWhy have you come back to me?
english.completion: Tirion sent you to Remulos? I'm... I'm flattered. One does not call favors in with beings of such power idly, no matter how noble or altruistic they might be. You too are kind to have gone to such lengths on my behalf. You have my thanks.$B$BPlant the seed - I am ready.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at Silent Vigil in Icecrown.

enders.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 仍有时间
text.objectives: 向北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁汇报翡翠橡果的效果。
text.description: 我感受到了新生的力量……但是瘟疫还残留在我体内。别担心，我永远感激你为我付出的努力，陌生人。不管怎样，你为我争取到了宝贵的时间，让我不致于很快化身亡灵，祸害世界。$B$B谢谢你，$c。请你向提里奥转达我的谢意。告诉提里奥，能为他效劳是我的荣幸。
text.completion: 翡翠橡果不具功效的消息，令我感到悲伤。不过我们没有时间沉浸在悲伤里，我必须继续寻求其它可能的帮助。

english.title: Time Yet Remains
english.objectives: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of Emerald Acorn's effects.
english.description: I feel refreshed... renewed... but the plague still grips me. Not to worry, I am still eternally grateful that you went to such lengths for me, a complete stranger. If nothing else, you've bought me a few more precious hours not plaguing the world as a hideous undead.$B$BThank you, $c. Please extend my thanks to Tirion as well, and let him know that it has been an honor to serve beside him.
english.completion: It saddens me to hear that it did not work. No reason to fret though, I have met other beings of good that may still be of aid to us.

starters.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 龙神的触摸
text.objectives: 向龙眠神殿的阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者请求帮助。
text.description: 红龙女王阿莱克丝塔萨掌握着生命的魔法。她曾经用烈焰焚毁亡灵，并让新的生命从它们的灰烬中诞生。她的力量或许能够拯救布雷登布莱德。$B$B阿莱克丝塔萨就住在龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿——请你去见她，代表我谦卑地请求她的帮助。
text.completion: 你好，$r。$B$B你来见我的原因，已经写在你的脸上了。请告诉我，什么令你愁容满面。

english.title: The Touch of an Aspect
english.objectives: Request the aid of Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: The dragon-queen, Alexstrasza, possesses magics over all life. In the past, she has used great fire to incinerate undead and rebirth fresh new life in their place. Perhaps her powers might be able to save our Bridenbrad as well.$B$BAlexstrasza makes her home at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight - please go to her and humbly request her aid on my behalf.
english.completion: Greetings to you, $r.$B$BThe concern is clear on your face. Please tell me what troubles you.

enders.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 达莉亚之泪
text.objectives: 龙眠神殿的阿莱克丝塔萨要你从被红玉看守者的烈焰净化过的土壤里取得达莉亚之泪。
text.description: 在这黑暗的时代，我绝不能抛弃圣光的勇士。$B$B我们需要一些神圣的对象，才有可能拯救布雷登布莱德……唯有感染过亡灵瘟疫，并且已经重获新生的虔诚生灵才具备免疫这种侵蚀的能力。$B$B我要你进入红玉巨龙圣地。我的红玉看守者曾以烈焰灼烧过那片被亡灵踏足的土地，你会发现新的生命已经开始生长。将那些正在茁壮生长的达莉亚之泪带回来给我。
text.progress: 啊，亲爱的达莉亚。我多么地想念你。
text.completion: 有了达莉亚之泪和古老的魔法，我可以赋予你拯救伟大北伐军战士的一丝希望。
text.completed: 去龙骨荒野找龙眠神殿的阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者。

english.title: Dahlia's Tears
english.objectives: Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple has requested that you recover Dahlia's Tears from soil freshly cleansed by a Ruby Keeper's flames.
english.description: In this dark time, I'll not be the one to abandon a champion of the Light.$B$BWe will need something sacred for this to have a hope of saving your Bridenbrad... a remnant of a devout being that fell victim to this very same plague.$B$BGo now to the sacred soil of the passages outside my Ruby Dragonshrine where the battle is joined. As my Ruby Keepers fly down and set flame to the ground beneath undead feet, you will witness new life grow forth. Among that life are Dahlia's Tears - bring them to me.
english.progress: Ah, dear Dahlia. I do miss you so.
english.completion: With Dahlia's Tears and ancient magic, I fashion you some small amount of hope for your great crusader.
english.completed: Return to Alexstrasza the Life-Binder at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

starters.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

enders.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

text.title: 阿莱克丝塔萨的恩赐
text.objectives: 将阿莱克丝塔萨之息交给冰冠冰川沉默墓地的北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。
text.description: 你必须明白，年轻的$r，我的能力仅限于净化躯体以促成新生……要在不影响肉体的前提下解除亡灵瘟疫，却已经超越了我的能力范围。$B$B如果布雷登布莱德真的像你所说的那样虔诚，他或许能通过净化的考验，获得新生。但是，我不确定这是否就是你所寻找的救赎之道。带着它和我的祝福上路吧。
text.progress: 你又回来了，$C。为什么你要一再地涉险？
text.completion: 阿莱克丝塔萨之息……你去找红龙女王本人？言语无法表达我心中感激之万一。$B$B我了解净化的风险，也已经做好准备。动手吧，$C。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找沉默墓地的北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。

english.title: The Boon of Alexstrasza
english.objectives: Bring the Breath of Alexstrasza to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown.
english.description: You must understand, young $r, that cleansing the body in favor of life anew is something well within my grasp... removing the plague of undeath without affecting the body, however, is beyond the scope of the powers that I control.$B$BIf this Bridenbrad is the beacon of light that you profess him to be, perhaps he will endure such a cleansing and thrive, but I cannot state with confidence that this is the salvation that you seek. Take it and go with all of my blessings.
english.progress: You have returned yet again, $c. Why do you risk yourself so?
english.completion: The breath of Alexstrasza... you have gone to the dragon-queen herself? I'm extremely grateful.$B$BI understand the risks of such cleansing and I am prepared. Proceed, $c.
english.completed: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at Silent Vigil in Icecrown.

starters.name: 阿莱克丝塔萨，生命的缚誓者

enders.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 仍有希望
text.objectives: 向北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁汇报阿莱克丝塔萨之息的效果。
text.description: <布雷登布莱德屏住呼吸，向你扬了扬手。>$B$B净化过程的确异常痛苦，但是我能感受到体内的堕落气息被烈焰吞噬了。可惜亡灵的瘟疫似乎很难彻底清除。$B$B$C，谢谢你为我所做的一切。你的无私行动让我重新燃起了希望，这个世界还是存在着像你这样的好心人——即便我离开了，黑暗也终将被战胜。现在我终于可以安心了。$B$B走吧，不必再心存遗憾了。
text.completion: 天灾瘟疫的确是非常的棘手——这从阿莱克丝塔萨的话中不难理解，要从如此无情的命运中拯救布雷登布莱德也许不太乐观，但我不会如此轻易地放弃他。$B$B仍然还有一线光明，还有一个存在或许能扭转他的悲惨命运。

english.title: Hope Yet Remains
english.objectives: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle with news of the effects of the Breath of Alexstrasza.
english.description: <Bridenbrad raises a hand to you as he catches his breath.>$B$BIt was nearly as painful as it looked, but it was as if I could feel some of the corruption being burnt away from within my body. It seems the plague is not so readily bested though.$B$B$C, thank you for everything that you have done. Your selfless actions have renewed my hope that there is yet great good left within this world - I can depart without fear that darkness will prevail in my absence.$B$BGo now, go with no regrets.
english.completion: The Scourge plague is no simple foe to defeat. Alexstrasza's words suggest that perhaps we can yet save our Bridenbrad from the unimaginable fate of the unliving should he fall, but I will not give him up so easily.$B$BThere is yet one more path of light I would like to pursue. One more being who might avert this horrible fate.

starters.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 纳鲁的意志
text.objectives: 向沙塔斯城的阿达尔求助。
text.description: 非常感谢你为我们所做的一切，$n。还有最后一件差事要麻烦你……我们愿意付出任何代价来拯救这位圣骑士，如今我们也只剩最后一丝希望了。$B$B我要你转至沙塔斯城，与纳鲁阿达尔谈一谈。长久以来，他一直是圣光的象征，是圣骑士强大的盟友。将布雷登布莱德的事迹告诉他，恳求他给予帮助。$B$B请你赶快行动，时间就是生命——我担心他在这个世界的时日已经不多了。
text.completion: <当你接近纳鲁，一阵轻柔的铃声在你的耳际与脑海中萦绕。>$B$B我知道你为何而来。

english.title: The Will of the Naaru
english.objectives: Request the aid of A'dal at Shattrath City in Terokkar Forest.
english.description: I appreciate everything that you have done for us, $n. I have one last errand for you... one last gleaming hope for a paladin who deserves any salvation that we can extend.$B$BGo now to Shattrath and speak to the naaru, A'dal. He has long been a beacon of light and powerful ally to devout paladins. Impart Bridenbrad's story and seek any aid that he might have to offer.$B$BI cannot impress how important it is that you move quickly - I fear our crusader does not have much more time in this world.
english.completion: <A gentle ringing fills your head as you approach the naaru.>$B$BI know why you have come.

text.title: 阿达尔的恩赐
text.objectives: 返回冰冠冰川，在沉默墓地找到北伐军战士布雷登布莱德。
text.description: 我很高兴你能来找我，$n。我已经知晓了北伐军战士布雷登布莱德的事迹，也知道你正在为了救他而四处奔波。布雷登布莱德的英勇激发了你的慷慨无私，这本身就是一个奇迹。$B$B圣光有自愈的能力。我会祝福布雷登布莱德，使他不会遭受亡灵的腐蚀。我要把你送回达拉然，而你要快点回去见他。记住，我与你同在。
text.completion: <当你接近北伐军战士布雷登布莱德时，你发现他已是面容惨白、气若游丝，看来他的时间所剩无几了。>$B$B你又回来了，$C，我不得不说……再次见到你真好……你的脸孔让我重拾希望，这块大陆终会从阿尔萨斯的魔掌中解放。我很荣幸和你相会……$B$B<布雷登布莱德的声音渐弱，一抹黯淡的微笑却始终挂在他脸上。在其油尽灯枯之际，一阵轻柔的铃声流进你耳间。>

english.title: The Boon of A'dal
english.objectives: Return to Crusader Bridenbrad at the Silent Vigil in Icecrown.
english.description: I am pleased that you have come to me, $n. I know of Crusader Bridenbrad, and of your travels in hope of saving him. Bridenbrad's valor has sparked remarkable selflessness in you, and this is a miracle unto itself.$B$BThe Light will take care of its own. I will extend my blessing to Bridenbrad and he shall not endure the corruption of undeath. I shall return you to Dalaran, and you shall return to him. Know that I remain with you.
english.completion: <As you approach Crusader Bridenbrad, you cannot help but notice that his skin has taken on a pale hue and his breaths are shallow. It is clear that he has little time left.>$B$BYou have returned to me, $c. I must admit... it is good to see you again... your face renews my hope that this land will be free of Arthas's grasp one day soon. I'm proud to have met you...$B$B<Bridenbrad's words trail off, a dim smile on his face. As life seems to slip from him, a gentle ringing fills your ears.>

enders.name: 北伐军战士布雷登布莱德

text.title: 黑暗中的光明
text.objectives: 将布雷登布莱德的战袍交给北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁。
text.description: <北伐军战士布雷登布莱德的战袍放在箱子底部。呼啸的寒风掠过时，战袍微微拂动起来。>$B$B提里奥一定很希望留下这位伟大的北伐军圣骑士最后的遗物。
text.progress: 他已逝去，是吗？我感觉到这块大陆上的光明又黯淡了一些。
text.completion: 我很高兴你拯救了他，让他不致成为不死邪物。有了阿达尔的祝福，他知道在他死后，邪恶的阴影将无法如影随行。$B$B我们会牢记他的精神，还有你无私的义行。再一次感谢你，为了你所做一切。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找北伐军之峰的大领主提里奥·弗丁。

english.title: Light Within the Darkness
english.objectives: Bring Crusader Bridenbrad's Tabard to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle.
english.description: <Crusader Bridenbrad's tabard rests in the bottom of the chest, shifting slightly as the howling wind finds its way in.>$B$BTirion will desire this last remnant of the great crusader.
english.progress: He has departed, hasn't he? I felt a small bit of light leave the land.
english.completion: I am glad you were able to save him from undeath. With A'dal's blessing, he will know no evil in his afterlife.$b$bWe shall take heart in his shining example and in your selflessness. Thank you for all that you have done.
english.completed: Return to Highlord Tirion Fordring at Crusaders' Pinnacle in Icecrown.

text.title: 破坏尤顿海姆
text.objectives: 暗影拱顶的兰克拉尔公爵要你烧毁10面维库人旗帜。
text.description: 我们来瞧瞧能否进一步打击维库人的信心，$N。$B$B我希望你每天都去尤顿海姆跑一趟，烧毁他们的旗帜。这虽说是件小事，但是维库人很快就会发现，他们的世袭之地每天都在遭到破坏和侮辱。我相信这比肉体伤害来得更痛苦，一定能狠狠地打击他们的士气。$B$B至少……你也没什么损失嘛。
text.progress: 你有更多活得干罗。
text.completion: <公爵盯着你一会，然后点了点头。>$B$B你给尤顿海姆的维库人带来了可怕的心理创伤。尤顿海姆对他们而言是无与伦比的地方，其重要性仅次于伊米海姆。$B$B你应该继续对此处施加压力，而我要守住这座穹殿抵抗巫妖王的攻势。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找暗影拱顶的兰克拉尔公爵。

english.title: Vandalizing Jotunheim
english.objectives: Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault wants you to burn 10 Vrykul Banners.
english.description: Let us see if we can further weaken the resolve of the vrykul, $N.$B$BEach day I wish you to travel to Jotunheim and put their banners to the torch. It may seem a trivial thing, but to see their ancestral home vandalized on a daily basis will demoralize them more than any physical punishment you can inflict.$B$BAt least... it can't hurt.
english.progress: You have more work to do.
english.completion: <The duke looks at you a moment and nods.>$B$BYou're inflicting horrible mental trauma on the Jotunheim vrykul. This is where they were first reawakened. It is a place of significant importance to them, second only to Ymirheim.$B$BYou must keep up the pressure there while I hold the vault from the assault of the Lich King.
english.completed: Return to Duke Lankral at The Shadow Vault in Icecrown.

text.title: 维林回来了
text.objectives: 与暗影拱顶内被折磨的维林谈一谈。
text.description: 我看见被折磨的维林偷偷溜进了暗影拱顶。这个无能的蠢货！$B$B我想知道他有没有悔过自新，还打不打算将我的死亡骑士还给我！这件事就交给你来办吧。
text.completion: 我来猜猜你为何在这，$N。

english.title: Vaelen Has Returned
english.objectives: Speak with Vaelen the Flayed at The Shadow Vault.
english.description: I just saw that incompetent fool, Vaelen the Flayed, sneak into the vault building.$B$BGo see to it that he rectifies his mistake and returns my death knights to me!
english.completion: I think I can guess why you're here, $N.

text.title: 最后一道防线
text.objectives: 使用银色火炮消灭100名天灾军团攻击者和3条霜巢毁灭者。$B$B完成任务后向攻城大师菲斯克复命。
text.description: 前线基地已经启动防御方案，$c！基地中的四座塔楼顶层分别安置着一门可伸缩的银色北伐军火炮，它们都得到过古斯塔夫神父的祝福。我要你飞到塔楼顶层去操纵火炮，用它摧毁巫妖王麾下的天灾军团部队。$B$B你只需注意一点：天灾军团肯定会派出冰霜巨龙来围攻塔楼，你必须击落这些野兽！如果巨龙摧毁了基地的城墙和塔楼，我们就完蛋了！
text.progress: 那些垂死的嘶吼老是令我不快！给他们个痛快！
text.completion: 你操作大炮的技术简直就像个地精炮手，我的朋友。你拯救了前线基地和银色北伐军——如同大领主本人就在战场上一般！真惊人！
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色前线基地的攻城大师菲斯克。

english.title: The Last Line Of Defense
english.objectives: Use an Argent Cannon to destroy 100 Scourge attackers. You must also kill 3 Frostbrood Destroyers.$B$BReturn to Siegemaster Fezzik should you succeed.
english.description: I've triggered the base's defenses, $c! Atop each of the Vanguard's four towers is a retractable Argent Crusade cannon, blessed by Father Gustav himself. You'll need to fly up to one of those towers and man a cannon. Use it to destroy the Scourge onslaught that the Lich King has deployed.$B$BJust one warning, the Scourge will undoubtedly send their frost wyrms to lay siege to the towers. Shoot them out of the sky! If they destroy the walls and towers of this base, we're done for!
english.progress: The screams of the dying will haunt me forever! Help them!
english.completion: You handled the cannon like a goblin gunner, friend. You've saved the Vanguard and the Argent Crusade - all the while backing the Highlord himself up on the field of battle! Amazing!
english.completed: Return to Siegemaster Fezzik at the Argent Vanguard in Icecrown.

text.title: 诺森德的厨师
text.objectives: 将4块冰冷的肉交给瓦加德的布罗姆。你可以在诺森德的任意野兽身上找到冰冷的肉。
text.description: 你有东西吃吗？我快饿死了！至少给我弄点冰冷的肉来吧，这样我就能自己做些诺森德炖肉了！如果你能帮我弄来一些冰冷的肉，我就教你怎么做炖肉，这样你也能自己炖肉吃。现在就去给我弄些肉来！
text.progress: 我的肉在哪！
text.completion: 你给我弄来了肉！食谱拿去，我得煮饭了！
text.completed: 去嚎风峡湾找瓦加德的布罗姆。

english.title: Northern Cooking
english.objectives: Bring four chilled meat to Brom Brewbaster at Valgarde.   Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.
english.description: So what are ya doin' if you dinna have any stew for me.   I got me a HUNGER!   At least bring me some chilled meat so I kin cook me own stew!   If ya do, I kin give ya the recipe so you kin make it for yourself.   NOW GO GET ME SOME MEAT!
english.progress: WHERE IS MY MEAT!
english.completion: Ya gots me meat!  Here is your recipe, I gots cookin to do!
english.completed: Return to Brom Brewbaster at Valgarde in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 诺森德的厨师
text.objectives: 将4块冰冷的肉交给无畏要塞的罗里克·玛克雷尔。你可以在诺森德的任意野兽身上找到冰冷的肉。
text.description: 我们这里来了很多新兵，这些家伙都还饿着肚子呢！如果你能去帮我弄些冰冷的肉，我就可以做一些诺森德炖肉了，当然，我也可以教你炖肉的方法。
text.progress: 这些孩子们需要煮诺森德炖肉的肉块。
text.completion: 这下可以喂饱咱们的新兵了！来，这是烹调的方法。
text.completed: 去北风苔原找无畏要塞的罗里克·玛克雷尔。

english.title: Northern Cooking
english.objectives: Bring four chilled meat to Rollick Mackreel at Valiance Keep.   Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.
english.description: We got a lot of new recruits here and these lads are hungry!  If you could go out and get me some chilled meat for stew, I could teach you how to make it for yourself.
english.progress: The lads need meat for their stew.
english.completion: That will keep our recruits fed!   Here's how you cook it.
english.completed: Return to Rollick MacKreel at Valiance Keep in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 诺森德的厨师
text.objectives: 将4块冰冷的肉交给复仇港的托马斯·克里奇。你可以在诺森德的任意野兽身上找到冰冷的肉。
text.description: 没有什么能比用新鲜的肉烹制而成的诺森德炖肉更能让你感到暖和了。从那些凶猛的野兽身上弄些冰冷的肉来，我会教你怎样做出热腾腾的诺森德炖肉。
text.progress: 都在等着炖肉呢……
text.completion: 我们立刻就能把这堆生肉变成香喷喷的炖肉。
text.completed: 去嚎风峡湾找复仇港的托马斯·克里奇。

english.title: Northern Cooking
english.objectives: Bring four chilled meat to Thomas Kolichio at Vengeance Landing.   Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.
english.description: Nothing like a stew made from the living to warm your bones.   Bring me some of the chilled meat that can be found on the wretched beasts of this place, and I shall teach you to make a warm stew.
english.progress: The stew awaits...
english.completion: We can quickly turn this flesh into stew.
english.completed: Return to Thomas Kolichio at Vengeance Landing in Howling Fjord.

text.title: 诺森德的厨师
text.objectives: 将4块冰冷的肉交给战歌要塞的奥恩·嫩蹄。你可以在诺森德的任意野兽身上找到冰冷的肉。
text.description: 战歌要塞的士兵需要吃饱喝足才能保持充沛的体力。如果你能从犀牛或者其它野兽身上收集一些冰冷的肉，我就可以给他们做些诺森德炖肉。而且，如果你乐意的话，我也很愿意教你学会烹制这道菜的方法。
text.progress: 只要有肉块，诺森德炖肉就准备好了。
text.completion: 我向你致谢。
text.completed: 去北风苔原找战歌要塞的奥恩·嫩蹄。

english.title: Northern Cooking
english.objectives: Bring four chilled meat to Orn Tenderhoof at Warsong Hold.   Chilled meat can be found on any Northrend beast.
english.description: The warriors of the Warsong Offensive need food in their bellies to keep their strength up.   If you could bring some chilled meats from the Rhinos or other beasts, I could make them some stew.   I would be willing to teach you the recipe if you were willing.
english.progress: When the meat is present, the stew will be prepared.
english.completion: I give my thanks to you.
english.completed: Return to Orn Tenderhoof at Warsong Hold in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 恐怖之水
text.objectives: 约尔达村的白骨女巫要你控制一个恐怖之水，利用它杀死尤顿海姆地区的10名维库人。$B$B尤顿海姆休眠看守者、尤顿海姆战士、尤尔丁控水师、约尔达女矛手和瓦哈拉斯行尸都符合要求。
text.description: 洞穴外面的水牢里塞满了尚未被维库人法师驯服的元素生物。我可以教你一个办法，让你在短时间内控制这些生物，接着你就可以利用它们破坏尤顿海姆！$B$B<被女妖附身的维库人从空气中汲取魔法，然后将她硕大的手指点在你的前额。>$B$B去吧，打开水牢。控制一只恐怖之水，利用它消灭我们的敌人！
text.progress: 我对骸骨的解读显示，你还没完成你的工作。
text.completion: 我从未在维库人的眼中看到如此的恐惧。他们以为可以掌握他们自己的小世界。$B$B我们这就要证明他们错了——错得离谱。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找约尔达村的白骨女巫。
text.objective1: 控制恐怖之水并杀死尤顿海姆维库人

english.title: The Art of Being a Water Terror
english.objectives: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village wants you to possess a Water Terror and use it to slay 10 vrykul in the greater Jotunheim region.$B$BQualifying vrykul are Jotunheim Sleep-Watchers, Jotunheim Warriors, Mjordin Water Magi, Njorndar Spear-Sisters, and Valhalas Vargul.
english.description: The water lock outside my cave is teeming with elementals that the vrykul magi have yet to tame. I am going to teach you a trick for possessing these creatures for a short time, and you will use them to wreak havoc upon Jotunheim!$B$B<The banshee-infested vrykul draws magic in the air and touches a large finger to your forehead.>$B$BGo now and open the gate to the lock. A water terror will rush out and you will possess it to destroy our enemies!
english.progress: My reading of the bones tells me that you're not quite done.
english.completion: I have never seen such terror in the eyes of a vrykul. They think themselves masters of their world.$B$BYou and I are going to prove them wrong. Very wrong.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Jotunheim vrykul slain while possessing a Water Terror

spells.name: The Art of Being a Water Terror: Quest Complete Script Effect

text.title: 占命卜运
text.objectives: 约尔达村的女巫要你去收集15个维库人的徽记。
text.description: 占据这名维库人的好处之一就是，我可以使用她的全部力量。作为一名女巫和符文解读者，她可以通过抛掷徽记来决定别人的命运。$B$B<女巫露出得意的笑容。>$B$B幸运的是，我有能力左右占卜的结果。$B$B我要你去尤顿海姆干掉一些维库人，把他们的徽记带回来给我。我可以抛掷徽记，让你决定自己的命运。
text.progress: 我有个有趣的发现，这支族群当他们使用如此原始的魔法时曾经支配过整个世界。
text.completion: 现在，我们该看看未来有什么在等着你。$B$B<白骨女巫将徽记放在她面前的毯子上。>$B$B选择你的命运吧，$C。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找约尔达村的白骨女巫。

english.title: Reading the Bones
english.objectives: The Bone Witch in Njorndar Village has instructed you to collect 15 Vrykul Bones.
english.description: One of the benefits of possessing this creature is that I have access to all of her powers. As a bone witch and rune reader, she has the power to throw the bones and determine one's fate.$B$B<The Bone Witch smirks.>$B$BLucky for you and I that I have it within my power to influence those readings.$B$BBring me the bones of the vrykul that you kill here in Jotunheim and I will toss them to allow you to determine your own fate.
english.progress: I find it remarkable that these beings ever held sway over the world when they utilized such primitive magic.
english.completion: And now we shall see what the future holds for you.$b$b<The Bone Witch casts the bones upon the rug in front of her.>$b$bChoose your fate, $c.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch at Njorndar Village in Icecrown.

text.title: 占命卜运
text.progress: 带给我更多的维库骸骨，我们就能依你首选，操控你的命运。
text.completion: 选择你的命运吧，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的白骨女巫。

english.title: Reading the Bones
english.progress: Bring me more vrykul bones and we will influence the fates in your favor.
english.completion: Choose your fate, $N.
english.completed: Return to The Bone Witch in Icecrown.

text.title: 他们丝毫不感到羞愧吗？
text.objectives: 图书馆员塞尔拉希望你进入魔枢，找回伯林纳德的研究笔记。
text.description: 大法师伯林纳德是肯瑞托之中对玛里苟斯的研究最深入的人。他一生都在对玛里苟斯和他的行为进行研究。$B$B前不久，他把他的研究笔记借给了我，上面记载着玛里苟斯正在试图绘制的某种被称为“魔网地图”之类的东西。但我犯了一个错误……我在跟一群借地落脚的部落冒险者聊天的时候说起了这本笔记——现在它消失了！$B$B一定是他们干的，$c。请进入魔枢，在伯林纳德向我要回研究笔记之前帮我把它找回来。
text.progress: 拜托，$N，告诉我你找到伯林纳德的研究笔记了……
text.completion: 你找到了！？哦是的，东西都在这儿了。$B$B请容我表达谢意。如果可以的话，伯林纳德最好别知道这件事。
text.completed: 去北风苔原找永生之盾的图书馆员塞尔拉。

english.title: Have They No Shame?
english.objectives: Librarian Serrah wants you to enter the Nexus and recover Berinand's Research.
english.description: Archmage Berinand is the Kirin Tor's foremost authority on Malygos. He's spent his life studying the aspect and his behaviors.$b$bRecently, he loaned me his research on the Arcanomicron, some sort of map that Malygos is trying to assemble. I made the mistake of discussing it with a group of Horde adventurers while they were restocking their goods here - and now it's gone!$b$bIt must have been them, $c. Please, follow them into the nexus and recover the book before Berinand comes to recover it.
english.progress: Please, $n, tell me you've found Berinand's research....
english.completion: You found it!? Yes, yes, it's all here.$b$bPlease, take this with my gratitude. And if it's not too much to ask, it would be better for me if Berinand never learned of this.
english.completed: Return to Librarian Serrah at the Transitus Shield in Borean Tundra.

text.title: 他们丝毫不感到羞愧吗？
text.objectives: 图书馆员塞尔拉希望你进入魔枢，找回伯林纳德的研究笔记。
text.description: 大法师伯林纳德是肯瑞托之中对玛里苟斯的研究最深入的人。他一生都在对玛里苟斯和他的行为进行研究。$B$B前不久，他把他的研究笔记借给了我，上面记载着玛里苟斯正在试图绘制的某种被称为“魔网地图”之类的东西。但我犯了一个错误……我在跟一群借地落脚的联盟冒险者聊天的时候说起了这本笔记——现在它消失了！$B$B一定是他们干的，$c。请进入魔枢，在伯林纳德向我要回研究笔记之前帮我把它找回来。
text.progress: 拜托，$N，告诉我你找到伯林纳德的研究笔记了……
text.completion: 你找到了！？哦是的，东西都在这儿了。$B$B请容我表达谢意。如果可以的话，伯林纳德最好别知道这件事。
text.completed: 去北风苔原找永生之盾的图书馆员塞尔拉。

english.objectives: Librarian Serrah wants you to enter the Nexus and recover Berinand's Research.

He's spent his life studying the aspect and his behaviors.$b$bRecently, he loaned me his research on the Arcanomicron, some sort of map that Malygos is trying to assemble. I made the mistake of discussing it with a group of Alliance adventurers while they were restocking their goods here - and now it's gone!$b$bIt must have been them, $c. Please, follow them into the nexus and find the book before Berinand comes to recover it from me.
