text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 啊，说实话，光靠锋利的钢剑是不足以获得胜利的。其它参赛者用的都是附有魔法的武器，这对我非常不利，不过这也不是什么大问题。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: 你能拿到那柄剑吗？
text.completion: 所以传说是真的？有了这么一柄好剑，我一定能在联赛中好好发挥。非常感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的拉娜·硬锤。

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $N. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Lana Stouthammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？$B$B下午就要进行比赛了，而我的剑却无影无踪了。$B$B一位吟游诗人告诉我，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去一朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵的交界处。
text.progress: 吟游诗人的传说是真的吗？你拿到剑了没？
text.completion: <勇士从你手上接过达克玛尔之剑。>$B$B真是一把好剑，完美的平衡性。这一定能让我在下一场比赛好好发挥。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的拉娜·硬锤。

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$B$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.
english.completed: Return to Lana Stouthammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的兰娜·硬锤。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B转至晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬转至嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$N。
text.progress: 你拿到我要找的剑了吗？
text.completion: 这柄剑真是名不虚传。看来不需要修复我原有的那把剑了。冬之利刃远远超过我的旧剑，我会继续使用它。我由衷地感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的拉娜·硬锤。

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Lana Stouthammer at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring her Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $N.
english.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Lana Stouthammer in Icecrown.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的鲁洛·强击要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.completion: 看来你刚热身完毕，$N。在我们为了参赛而加紧练习时，别忘了天灾军团还在外头肆虐着。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的鲁洛·强击。

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Rollo Sureshot at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $N. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.
english.completed: Return to Rollo Sureshot in Icecrown.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的克拉拉·沸酒。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。铁炉堡的人民期待着我们胜利的消息。为了这个目标，我们要不断地与代表联盟其它城市出战的勇士们比武练习，提升自己的战斗能力。$B$B我推荐你也参加。勇士们的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面。拿起你的长枪，到大帐外面的兽栏中去，骑上兽栏中的铁炉堡战羊，去挑战其它的联盟勇士吧。
text.progress: 你完成了技击大赛的训练吗？
text.completion: 干得好。和其他勇士对战是为联赛做准备的最佳方法。我知道你一定会让铁炉堡的人民引以为傲的，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的克拉拉·沸酒。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Clara Tumblebrew at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. The people of Ironforge are looking forward to hearing of our success. To that end, they've been honing their skills against the valiants representing the other Alliance capitals.$B$BI suggest you do the same. The valiants practice in the ring just outside our tent. Equip your lance, go to the stables outside the pavilion and mount the stabled Ironforge ram, then challenge other Alliance valiants.$B
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make Ironforge proud, $N.
english.completed: Return to Clara Tumblebrew in Icecrown.

text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的弗林克·扳钳。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Flickin Gearspanner at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. We know everyone's looking forward to seeing us in the competition. To that end, we've been honing our skills against the valiants representing the other Alliance capitals.$B$BI suggest you do the same.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled turbostrider, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Alliance Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.$B
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make us proud, $N.
english.completed: Return to Flickin Gearspanner in Icecrown.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的科鲁索斯。
text.description: 啊，说实话，光靠锋利的钢剑是不足以获得胜利的。其它参赛者用的都是附有魔法的武器，这对我非常不利，不过这也不是什么大问题。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: 你能拿到那柄剑吗？
text.completion: 所以传说是真的？有了这么一柄好剑，我一定能在联赛中好好发挥。非常感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的克罗索斯。

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Good, honest, honed steel may not carry the day. The other combatants are using enchanted blades and I find myself at a disadvantage, but all is not lost.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $N. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This is a fine blade and I have no doubt that it will serve me well in the tournament. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Colosos in Icecrown.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的科鲁索斯。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？$B$B下午就要进行比赛了，而我的剑却无影无踪了。$B$B一位吟游诗人告诉我，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去一朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵的交界处。
text.progress: 吟游诗人的传说是真的吗？你拿到剑了没？
text.completion: <勇士从你手上接过达克玛尔之剑。>$B$B真是一把好剑，完美的平衡性。这一定能让我在下一场比赛好好发挥。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的克罗索斯。

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$B$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: <The grand champion accepts the Blade of Drak'Mar from you.>$b$bA fine weapon, and perfectly balanced. It will serve me well in the next match.
english.completed: Return to Colosos in Icecrown.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的科鲁索斯。
text.description: 上次我一时头脑发热，跟一个死亡骑士打了一架，结果……唉。$B$B转至晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬转至嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$N。
text.progress: 你拿到我要找的剑了吗？
text.completion: 这柄剑真是名不虚传。看来不需要修复我原有的那把剑了。冬之利刃远远超过我的旧剑，我会继续使用它。我由衷地感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的克罗索斯。

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Colosos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: That's the last time I ever spar with a death knight.$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $N.
english.progress: Did you win the blade I seek?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Colosos in Icecrown.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的萨安度斯要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: 你有在对抗天灾军团的战斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 看来你刚热身完毕，$N。在我们为了参赛而加紧练习时，别忘了天灾军团还在外头肆虐着。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的萨安度斯。

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Saandos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.completion: Welcome back from your exercises, $N. Even while we practice for the competition, it's good to remind ourselves that the Scourge is still out there.
english.completed: Return to Saandos in Icecrown.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的兰妮。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。埃索达的人民期待着我们能获得这场比赛的胜利。为了这个目标，我们要不断地与其它的勇士们比武练习，提升自己的战斗能力。$B$B我推荐你也参加。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的秘蓝岛雷象，去挑战其它的勇士吧。联盟勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: 你完成了技击大赛的训练吗？
text.completion: 干得好。和其他勇士对战是为联赛做准备的最佳方法。我知道你一定会让我们引以为傲的，$N。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的兰妮。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Ranii at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. The people of the Exodar are looking forward to seeing us win the melee. To that end, they've been honing their skills against the valiants representing the other Alliance capitals.$B$BI suggest you do the same.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Azuremyst elekk, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Alliance Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other valiants is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make us proud, $N.
english.completed: Return to Ranii in Icecrown.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？$B$B下午就要进行比赛了，而我的剑却无影无踪了。$B$B一位吟游诗人告诉我，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去一朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵的交界处。
text.progress: 吟游诗人的传说是真的吗？你拿到剑了没？
text.completion: 这一把绝佳的武器，足以帮助我在比赛中获胜。感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$B$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: This is a fine weapon that will help me crush the competition. Thank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Mokra the Skullcrusher at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B转至晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬转至嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$N。
text.progress: 你赢得了那把剑吗？
text.completion: 这柄剑真是名不虚传。看来不需要修复我原有的那把剑了。冬之利刃远远超过我的旧剑，我会继续使用它。我由衷地感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的碎颅者莫克拉。

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Mokra the Skullcrusher at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $N.
english.progress: Did you win the blade?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Mokra the Skullcrusher at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的埃基诺斯要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: 你有在对抗天灾军团的战斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 一整天的训练没什么害处。很高兴看见你持续锻炼。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的埃基诺斯。

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Akinos at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completed: Return to Akinos at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的茉拉·狼女。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的奥格瑞玛座狼，去挑战其它的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: 你完成了技击大赛的训练吗？
text.completion: 和其他勇士彼此对战训练将能磨利你的爪子，锻炼你的战斗直觉。等到竞赛开始时，你将会做好准备。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的茉拉·狼女。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Morah Worgsister at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Orgrimmar wolf, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.$B$B
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.
english.completed: Return to Morah Worgsister at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给银色比武场的祖尔托。
text.description: 听说联盟的冠军都在为他们的战士寻找古代的兵器，我们可不能让他们占这个便宜。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: 你能拿到那柄剑吗？
text.completion: 所以传说是真的？这柄剑足以胜过所有联盟参赛者的配剑。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的祖尔托。

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Zul'tore at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I've heard that the Alliance champions are seeking after ancient blades for their warriors. We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $N. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This blade should be enough to best anything those Alliance entrants can come up with.
english.completed: Return to Zul'tore at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的加尔祖。

english.title: The Edge Of Winter
english.objectives: Runok Wildmane at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to bring him Winter's Edge.
english.description: Curse that death knight for breaking my sword!$B$BIn southern Crystalsong Forest, overlooking the Crystal Vice's exit, you will find Lord Everblaze. Kill him and take the everburning ember from his corpse.$B$BBring it to the center of Winter's Breath Lake in northern Howling Fjord, and use it to free the maiden encased in ice. She is the guardian of an ancient sword and will award it to whoever frees her.$B$BProve your worth and earn the weapon that she has guarded for so long, $N.
english.progress: Did you win the blade?
english.completion: The blade is as fine as the stories say. It would seem there's little reason to complete the repairs on my customary blade. Winter's Edge is far superior and I will continue to carry it. You have my thanks, $N.
english.completed: Return to Runok Wildmane at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 勇士的实战训练
text.objectives: 银色比武场的德恩·暴怒图腾要你消灭10名被转化的英雄。
text.description: 在锦标赛上，你可以和你的战友们一起练习技术，但是时刻都不要忘记，我们真正的敌人——天灾军团绝不会坐等灭亡。你不但要和队友切磋，还要在与敌人的战斗中磨砺自己的刀锋。$B$B到位于陨落英雄之谷西南和恐惧之门科雷萨以北的那个地区去。天灾军团正在那里复活死亡的英雄们，并将他们变成我们的敌人。击败那些天灾军团的爪牙，让我们的勇士得到安息，并在那里磨砺你的战斗技艺。
text.progress: 你有在对抗天灾军团的战斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 一整天的训练没什么害处。很高兴看见你持续锻炼。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的德恩·暴怒图腾。

english.title: A Valiant's Field Training
english.objectives: Dern Ragetotem at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 10 Converted Heroes.
english.description: The tournament is a time for testing your skills against your peers, but we must not forget that the real enemy, the Scourge, will not wait. As you hone your skills against others, so should you maintain your edge in combat against the enemy.$B$BTravel to the area southwest of the Valley of Fallen Heroes and north of Corp'rethar. There, the Scourge raises dead heroes and turns them against us. Defeat these minions of the Scourge, do honor to our allies, and keep yourself prepared for combat.
english.progress: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completion: A good day of training will never hurt anyone. It's good to see you keeping up.
english.completed: Return to Dern Ragetotem at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 总决赛
text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的安卡·爪蹄。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在夺日者大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的莫高雷科多兽，去挑战其它的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: 你完成了技击大赛的训练吗？
text.completion: 和其他勇士彼此对战训练将能磨利你的爪子，锻炼你的战斗直觉。等到竞赛开始时，你将会做好准备。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的安卡·爪蹄。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Anka Clawhoof at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Sunreaver Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Mulgore kodo, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.
english.completed: Return to Anka Clawhoof at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 冠军的利剑
text.objectives: 找到灰木之剑，把它交给带给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 听说联盟的冠军都在为他们的战士寻找古代的兵器，我们可不能让他们占这个便宜。$B$B一个流传于灰熊丘陵的古老传说中提到，那里有位女士为了守护一把剑受到诅咒，变成了一只青蛙。现在她就住在灰木哨站东边的灰木湖岸上，和其它的湖蛙生活在一起。根据传说，唯一能够解除这道诅咒的方法，是有人自愿去亲吻她。不过呢，你要记得先在嘴唇上涂抹这种药膏，然后再去亲吻湖蛙，不然你的嘴上会长疣的。
text.progress: 你能拿到那柄剑吗？
text.completion: 所以传说是真的？这柄剑足以胜过所有联盟参赛者的配剑。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的死亡猎手维赛里。

english.title: A Blade Fit For A Champion
english.objectives: Retrieve the Ashwood Brand and bring it to Deathstalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I've heard that the Alliance champions are seeking after ancient blades for their warriors. We can't afford to let them have that kind of advantage.$B$BThere's an old legend from Grizzly Hills about a maiden cursed with a frog's form to protect the blade she has long guarded. She lives among the lake frogs on the shore of Ashwood Lake, just east of Ashwood Post. The only thing said to break the curse is a kiss, freely given. Apply this balm before kissing anything, $N. Otherwise, you'll catch warts.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the blade?
english.completion: So the tales were true? This blade should be enough to best anything those Alliance entrants can come up with.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Visceri at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 珍贵的武器
text.objectives: 将达克玛尔之剑交给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 为什么我的运气总是烂到家了呢？$B$B下午就要进行比赛了，而我的剑却无影无踪了。$B$B一位吟游诗人告诉我，如果哪位旅人能给一位孤独的女士带去一朵冬水仙，就可以获得她的礼物。那些花只生长在铁墙大坝下游的浮冰上，就在晶歌森林的西北部，与冰冠冰川交界的地方。去摘些这种花，然后把花带到龙骨荒野东北部的达克玛尔湖去，就在该地区与祖达克、灰熊丘陵的交界处。
text.progress: 吟游诗人的传说是真的吗？你拿到剑了没？
text.completion: 这一把绝佳的武器，足以帮助我在比赛中获胜。感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的死亡猎手维赛里。

english.title: A Worthy Weapon
english.objectives: Bring the Blade of Drak'Mar to Deathsalker Visceri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: Of all the times to have such rotten luck!$B$BMy tournament blade has gone missing and I need it for a match this afternoon.$B$BOne of the bards tells me that travelers used to present winter hyacinths to a lonely maiden in return for gifts. Those hyacinths grow only on the ice flowing from the Ironwall Dam, on Crystalsong Forest's northwestern border with Icecrown. Gather the flowers and take them to Drak'Mar lake in northeastern Dragonblight, near its border with Zul'Drak and Grizzly Hills.
english.progress: Were the wandering bard's tales true? Have you brought a blade?
english.completion: This is a fine weapon that will help me crush the competition. Thank you, $N.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Visceri at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 冬之利刃
text.objectives: 将冬之利刃交给银色比武场的死亡猎手维瑟里。
text.description: 那个天杀的死亡骑士，把我的剑给弄坏了！$B$B转至晶歌森林的南部，你可以在水晶裂痕的出口上方找到恒焰领主。杀死他，拿到他身上的恒焰灰烬。$B$B带着恒焰灰烬转至嚎风峡湾北部的冬息湖中心，解救一位被寒冰困在那里的女士。她守护着一把古代宝剑，能够解救她的人就可以获得那把宝剑作为奖励。$B$B证明你的能力，拿到她守护了许久的宝剑吧，$N。
text.progress: 你赢得了那把剑吗？
text.completion: 这柄剑真是名不虚传。看来不需要修复我原有的那把剑了。冬之利刃远远超过我的旧剑，我会继续使用它。我由衷地感谢你，$N。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的死亡猎手维赛里。

text.objectives: 将三枚勇士的印记交给银色比武场的安妮拉·索隆。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 总决赛是锦标赛中最重要的一场比赛。胜利必然是来之不易的，但我们有必胜的信心。你必须严格训练你的坐骑，直到它和你融为一体。$B$B这可以帮助你保持战斗的活力。$B$B到大帐外面的兽栏中去，拿起你的长枪，骑上兽栏中的银月城陆行鸟，去挑战其它的勇士吧。部落勇士的练习场就在我们的帐篷外面，他们在那里等待你的挑战。
text.progress: 你完成了技击大赛的训练吗？
text.completion: 和其他勇士彼此对战训练将能磨利你的爪子，锻炼你的战斗直觉。等到竞赛开始时，你将会做好准备。
text.completed: 去冰冠冰川找银色比武场的安妮拉·索隆。

english.title: The Grand Melee
english.objectives: Bring 3 Marks of the Valiant to Aneera Thuron at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: The grand melee is the most important of the tournament's competitions. Victory will not be easy, but I am confident that we will win. You must practice with your mount until the two of you work as one.$B$BIt will help prepare you for the rigors of tournament combat.$B$BGo to the stables outside the pavilion, equip your lance, mount the stabled Silvermoon hawkstrider, and challenge the valiants. They wait in the Horde Valiants' Ring just outside our tent.$B$B
english.progress: Have you completed your training for the grand melee?
english.completion: Training against the other valiants will sharpen your claws and hone your battle insticts. When the competition begins, you will be ready.
english.completed: Return to Aneera Thuron at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 空中的威胁
text.objectives: 银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者要你消灭3名诅咒教派投弹手，并击败冰喉。
text.description: 自从你揪出诅咒教派的间谍之后，银色北伐军已经把赛场中的卫兵数量增加了一倍。只要这里还没有被夷为平地，只要锦标赛还没有被完全破坏，诅咒教徒就不会善罢甘休。$B$B银色北伐军的斥候发现了一支诅咒教派的部队，他们在一条名叫冰喉的冰霜巨龙的带领下向我们奔袭。$B$B你必须在他们发动攻击之前阻止他们。根据斥候的报告，冰喉就盘旋在我们的西南方向，铁墙大坝和奥尔杜萨交界的地方。
text.progress: 你击败了诅咒教派的突袭队吗？
text.completion: $N，你拯救了联赛免于毁灭性的攻击。银色北伐军以及在此的所有人都欠你一份情，我们会确保他们记得这件事。那些吹嘘要提供保护的人，保安官和天爪们花了太多时间在应付那些酒后争执，而非对抗天灾军团的威胁。$B$B但不管如何，我们总是能自我保护。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的科罗克·斩亡者。

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: The Argent Crusade has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. They know the cultists won't stop until they've destroyed this area and thwarted the tournament.$B$BThe Argent Crusade's scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party.$B$BYou must intercept and destroy them before they attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
english.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
english.completion: $N, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge.$b$bIt's no matter. We always protect our own.
english.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.

text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的塞利安·碎日要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭这些诅咒教派的成员。
text.description: 这座竞技场坐落在在世界上最危险的地方，$N。为了把这块土地从天灾军团手中夺过来，我们历经苦难，付出了极其沉重的代价。然而敌人仍然在持续不断地向我们发动攻击，仿佛他们有着无穷无尽的后备队。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，干掉你遇到的所有天灾士兵。
text.progress: 你有在战斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 你是个真正的勇士，$N，不论是在战场或是竞技场中都一样。我们应该要更谨慎地与天灾军团作战，而你对我们的同胞或你的同胞来说都是个伟大的榜样。
text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的塞利安·碎日。

english.title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
english.objectives: Cellian Daybreak at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill Cult of the Damned members in any part of Icecrown.
english.description: The coliseum is perched in the most dangerous part of the world, $N. The territory we've taken from the Scourge has been paid for in blood and misery, yet the enemy continues to strike back with a seemingly limitless army. To make matters worse, this undead army is supported and assisted by mortal sympathizers, the Cult of the Damned.$B$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any cultists you encounter.
english.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
english.completion: You are a true champion, $N, both inside the ring and on the field. We must all be vigilant against the Scourge and you are a great example to our brethren and your own people.
english.completed: Return to Cellian Daybreak at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: 将四枚冠军的印记交给银色比武场的鲁莉。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 作为冠军，你已经掌握了骑乘战斗的技巧，击败了各种层次的对手。现在，那些被你击败的对手正在加倍努力训练，当锦标赛开始的时候，他们会卷土重来，报那败北之仇。$B$B你最好不要松懈，继续与冠军赛场中的斗士们切磋，磨练自己的战斗技巧。拿起你的长枪，到赛场南部的兽栏中去骑上属于你的坐骑，面对各位冠军的挑战吧。
text.progress: 你完成了和其它勇士的练习吗？
text.completion: 干得好。和其它勇士进行对战练习是准备联赛的最佳方法。我知道你一定会让联盟引以为傲的，$N。
text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的鲁莉。

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Luuri at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.$B
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, besting challengers of all levels. When the tournament begins, those you have defeated will have redoubled their efforts and will seek to avenge their losses to you.$B$BIt would be wise to continue practicing your skills against the combatants waiting in the Ring of Champions. Equip your lance, go to the stables on the southern side of the grounds. then mount up on any mount you're permitted to use, and face the champions.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: Well done. Training against the other champions is one of the best ways to prepare yourself for tournament competition. I know you'll make the Alliance proud, $N.
english.completed: Return to Luuri at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的放血者佐尔比要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭那些异教徒。
text.description: 我们在仿真战中打闹的同时，不能忘了真正的敌人正环伺在我们周围。银色北伐军想通过比赛来选出最好的战士，但是真正的强者只能是那些从战场上生还的人。我们要让那帮圣骑士看看，在为锦标赛做准备的同时，我们也随时准备跟诅咒教派开战。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，杀死你遇到的所有异教徒。他们的力量在奥尔杜萨和亡语者岗哨周围尤其强大。
text.progress: 你有在斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 你证明了我们对抗天灾军团的承诺，不管我们在哪，也不管我们在做什么。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的放血者佐尔比。

english.title: Taking Battle To The Enemy
english.objectives: Zor'be the Bloodletter at the Argent Tournament Grounds wants you to kill 15 members of the Cult of the Damned. You may kill cultists in any part of Icecrown.
english.description: While we all play at mock combat, it will do us good to remember that the real enemy surrounds us. The Argent Crusade wants to use competition to find the best fighters, but we can tell that by who returns from battle. Let's show the paladins that we are willing to take battle to the Cult of the Damned, even while making preparations for the tournament.$B$BGo forth into Icecrown and slay any of the cultists you encounter. They have a strong presence around Aldur'thar and Deathspeaker's Watch.
english.progress: Have you tested yourself in combat against the Scourge?
english.completion: You have done well in demonstrating our commitment to fighting the Scourge, no matter where we are or what we are doing.
english.completed: Return to Zor'be the Bloodletter in Icecrown.
english.objective1: Cult of the Damned member slain

text.title: 冠军的比武
text.objectives: 将四枚冠军的印记交给银色比武场的伊尔蕾·夜幕。$B$B如果你丢失了长枪，可以在银色盟约大帐或者兽栏附近的长枪架上再拿一根。
text.description: 作为冠军，你已经掌握了骑乘战斗的技巧，击败了各种层次的对手。但你还是要继续练习，确保在锦标赛正式开始之后可以击败所有对手。$B$B你应该继续磨练自己的战斗技巧，了解对手的弱点。代表各个城市参战的冠军都在手兽栏旁的冠军赛场中练习。到兽栏中去骑上属于你的坐骑，然后面对各位冠军的挑战吧。
text.progress: 你完成了和其他勇士的练习吗？
text.completion: 你对坐骑的操控十分巧妙，$N。要不了多久，你的对手就会开始畏惧你。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的伊尔蕾·夜幕。

english.title: Among the Champions
english.objectives: Bring 4 Marks of the Champion to Illyrie Nightfall at the Argent Tournament Grounds.$B$BIf you lose your lance, you can get another from any of the Lance Racks near the stables or in the Silver Covenant Pavilion.
english.description: As a champion, you have mastered the art of mounted combat, overcoming challengers of all levels. You must make certain that you can defeat anyone you face when the tournament begins.$B$BYou should continue honing your own skills and learning more about the weaknesses of your opponents. Champions representing all cities practice in the Ring of Champions near the stables. Go to the stables, equip your lance, and pick any mount you're permitted to ride, then face the champions.
english.progress: Have you finished training with the other champions?
english.completion: You handle your mount well, $N. In time, your competitors will learn to fear you.
english.completed: Return to Illyrie Nightfall in Icecrown.

text.title: 纯洁者耶德瑞克
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克谈一谈。
text.description: 在我的提议下，银色北伐军的兄弟和新晋的冠军展开了紧密的合作。北伐军的总冠军——纯洁者耶德瑞克——负责帮助来自各个城市的冠军进行训练，为锦标赛的总决赛做好准备。$B$B去找他做个自我介绍吧，他肯定已经急着要见你，帮助你进行训练，准备与艾泽拉斯世界最伟大的冠军同台竞技。
text.completion: 很高兴终于见到你，勇士。大领主要我负责协助各勇士的一同练习与努力，必且强化联赛场地的防御。

english.title: Eadric the Pure
english.objectives: Speak with Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: I have asked my brothers of the Argent Crusade to work closely with those who rise to the rank of champion. Eadric the Pure, our brotherhood's grand champion, helps oversee training exercises for champions from all cities and helps them make their final preparations for tournament competition.$B$BPlease go and introduce yourself to him. I know he'll be eager to meet you and work with you on your way to competing against Azeroth's greatest champions.
english.completion: It's good to finally meet you, champion. The highlord has asked me to help coordinate the efforts of all champions to train together and bolster the defenses of the tournament grounds.

text.title: 科罗克·斩亡者
text.objectives: 与银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者谈一谈。
text.description: 黑锋骑士代表团的领袖要和你谈谈，$c。科罗克·斩亡者是一位令人胆寒的斗士，他肯定有很多话要和你说。$B$B黑锋骑士团在比武场的北部扎了营，就在联盟代表团的大帐西边。
text.completion: 所以你是个勇士了，$N。我毫不怀疑这一天的到来。我们的骑士是由心底锻炼着战斗，而不是对着木头假人。让那些圣骑士和他们的宾客瞧瞧，有什么样的战斗在等着我们。

english.title: The Scourgebane
english.objectives: Speak with Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
english.description: The leader of the Knights of the Ebon Blade delegation has asked to speak you, $c. Crok Scourgebane is as fearsome a combatant as they come and I have no doubt he'll have much to ask of you.$B$BThe Knights of the Ebon Blade have made camp on the north side of the tournament grounds, west of the tent housing the Alliance delegations.
english.completion: So you have become a champion, $N. I had no doubt that it would happen. We knights have been trained in the heat of battle, not in front of wooden dummies. Let's show the paladins and their guests what battle has made us.

text.title: 旗帜:联赛邀请
text.progress: 当一个玩家送出银白联赛邀请函邮件时，就会竖立起这根旗帜。

text.title: 空中的威胁
text.objectives: 银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克要你消灭3名诅咒教派投弹手，并击败冰喉。
text.description: 在你找出诅咒教派的间谍以后，大领主提里奥·弗丁安排了双倍的卫兵。弗丁大人认为诅咒教派不会仅仅因为失去一个黑骑士就善罢甘休。$B$B根据天爪龙斥候的报告，有一支诅咒教派的部队正准备袭击我们，他们的首领是一条名叫冰喉的冰霜巨龙。如果不阻止他们的话，赛场就会受到攻击。斥候们说，冰喉就盘旋在我们的西南方向，铁墙大坝和奥尔杜萨交界的地方。
text.progress: 你击败了诅咒教派的突袭队吗？
text.completion: $N，你和你的盟友帮助联赛免于毁灭性的攻击。虽然我们的天爪骑士非常英勇，但他们的人手几乎都用在维持联赛的地面安全，很难防范诅咒教派来自空中的攻击。银色北伐军和所有在此参与联赛的人都由衷地感谢你。
text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的纯洁者耶德瑞克。

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Eadric the Pure at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: Highlord Tirion Fordring has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. He doesn't believe that they will stop just because their Black Knight has been defeated.$B$BOur skytalon scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party. If we don't intercept them, the tournament will come under attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
english.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
english.completion: $N, you and your allies have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. Though our skytalon riders are brave, they have their hands full keeping the peace on the tournament grounds and would be hard-pressed to defend the skies against the cult's attack. You have the thanks of the Argent Crusade and all who have gathered here to compete.
english.completed: Return to Eadric the Pure at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

text.title: 攻入敌阵
text.objectives: 银色比武场的塞利安·碎日要你在冰冠冰川地区消灭15名诅咒教派成员。你可以在冰冠冰川的任何地方消灭这些诅咒教派的成员。

这座竞技场坐落在在世界上最危险的地方，$N。为了把这块土地从天灾军团手中夺过来，我们历经苦难，付出了极其沉重的代价。然而敌人仍然在持续不断地向我们发动攻击，仿佛他们有着无穷无尽的后备队。$B$B到冰冠冰川去，干掉你遇
到的所有天灾士兵。
text.progress: 你有在战斗中自我磨练吗？
text.completion: 你是个真正的勇士，$N，不论是在战场或是竞技场中都一样。我们应该要更谨慎地与天灾军团作战，而你对我们的同胞或你的同胞来说都是个伟大的榜样。
text.completed: 转至冰冠冰川，去找银色比武场的塞利安·碎日。

text.completion: 干得好。和其它勇士进行对战练习是准备联赛的最佳方法。我知道你一定会让部落引以为傲的，$N。

text.title: 空中的威胁
text.objectives: 银色比武场的科罗克·斩亡者要你消灭3名诅咒教派投弹手，并击败冰喉。
text.description: 自从你揪出诅咒教派的间谍之后，银色北伐军已经把赛场中的卫兵数量增加了一倍。只要这里还没有被夷为平地，只要锦标赛还没有被完全破坏，诅咒教徒就不会善罢甘休。$B$B银色北伐军的斥候发现了一支诅咒教派的部队，他们在一条名叫冰喉的冰霜巨龙的带领下向我们奔袭。$B$B你必须在他们发动攻击之前阻止他们。根据斥候的报告，冰喉就盘旋在我们的西南方向，铁墙大坝和奥尔杜萨交界的地方。
text.progress: 你击败了诅咒教派的突袭队吗？
text.completion: $N，你拯救了联赛免于毁灭性的攻击。银色北伐军以及在此的所有人都欠你一份情，我们会确保他们记得这件事。那些吹嘘要提供保护的人，保安官和天爪们花了太多时间在应付那些酒后争执，而非对抗天灾军团的威胁。$B$B但不管如何，我们总是能自我保护。
text.completed: 去找冰冠冰川的科罗克·斩亡者。

english.title: Threat From Above
english.objectives: Crok Scourgebane at the Argent Tournament wants you to defeat Chillmaw and 3 Cultist Bombardiers.
english.description: The Argent Crusade has doubled the guard since your exposure of the Cult of the Damned's infiltrator. They know the cultists won't stop until they've destroyed this area and thwarted the tournament.$B$BThe Argent Crusade's scouts have reported sighting a frost wyrm named Chillmaw leading a cult raiding party.$B$BYou must intercept and destroy them before they attack. The scouts reporting seeing Chillmaw to the southwest, flying over the area between the Ironwall Rampart and Aldur'thar.
english.progress: Have you defeated the Cult of the Damned raiding party?
english.completion: $N, you have spared the tournament from a devastating attack. The Argent Crusade and all who gather here are in our debt and we'll make certain they remember it. For all their bluster about providing protection, the peacekeepers and skytalons spend more time breaking up drunken brawls than keeping us safe from the Scourge.$b$bIt's no matter. We always protect our own.
english.completed: Return to Crok Scourgebane in Icecrown.
